m200562.――というわけで、\n今回の調査からは、主に現地の文明との接触が主眼となる。: So, the focus of this expedition will be making contact with the local civilization.
m200562.――というわけで、先遣隊の調査結果でーす。: So, here's the scouting party's report.
m200562.――まぁ、今はなにか、\nギルガメッシュといっしょに企んでるみたいだが。: …Anyway, right now he seems to be scheming with Gilgamesh.
m200562.……いや、解説されると恥ずかしいな。\nって、粗暴ってなんだよ粗暴って！: …No, it's embarrassing to have it explained like that. Hey, what do you even mean by “rough-mannered”?
m200562.……その可能性もゼロではないけれど、\nそこまで遡ったら、\nそもそも今まで継続: …that's not impossible, but if we go that far back, there shouldn't be any civilization that's survived until now, right?
m200562.……俺より、よほどしっかりしてると思ってたけどな。: …I thought you were way more reliable than me.
m200562.あっ、えっと、壮大な話が始まっちゃいそうな気配……？: ???: Ah, um, I get the feeling an epic story is about to start…?
m200562.あのぉ、ガルヴェインさん。\nよかったらこのまま、王国の味方になってくれたりは―: Um, Galwain… If you'd like, could you stay on the Kingdom's side from now on—?
m200562.あれ以降、何度か向こうの世界に\n小規模部隊で調査に出てるけど、\nあいつらの正: Since then, we've sent out small squads to that world a few times, but we still have no clue what they are.
m200562.おそらく物質界に匹敵する広さなのではないかと。: Probably comparable in size to the Material Realm.
m200562.この世界には、女神トラム信仰がある、と。: In this world, people worship the goddess Tram.
m200562.この世界を訪れた記憶はないのだけれど……。: I don't recall ever having visited this world…
m200562.この辺り一帯は、三つ目の種族に支配されているんです。\n彼らはあたしたちが発掘し: ???: This whole area is ruled by the “third race.” They've been snatching up artifacts we uncovered, shouting “We're the rightful owners!” and taking them away…
m200562.この里にはな、結構世話になってんだ。\n守るために手を貸してくれたこと、恩に着る: This village has taken good care of me. I'm indebted for the help you gave to protect it.
m200562.こほん。\nあちら側――仮にもうひとつの世界と呼びますが、\nその広さはかなりの: Ahem. Over there—let's call it another world—the scale is quite massive.
m200562.その上で、王子。\n言っておきたいことがあるんだが――: With that said, Prince—there's something I need to tell you—
m200562.その性格は粗暴なれど優しく、兵に慕われ、\n多くの活躍により、描かれた武勲詩は数: Though rough-mannered, he's kind, beloved by his troops, and his deeds are countless—so many ballads have been written about him. Most of them recount how he fought to protect innocent people.
m200562.その礼ってわけじゃないが、\nお前が困ってる時には、俺様が手を貸してやるよ。: It's not exactly a favor, but when you're in trouble, I'll lend you a hand.
m200562.それじゃあトラム様、お仲間の皆さまも！\n私の里へご案内します！: Then, Lady Tram… and everyone else! Let me guide you to my village!
m200562.ただ、物質界と同規模の、正体不明の世界に、\nいきなり王国軍の全軍を送り込むわけ: However, we can't just throw the entire kingdom's forces into an unknown world of that magnitude.
m200562.ただ、積極的にこちらを探したり、\n攻撃してきたりする意思はないようです。\n本: They don't seem intent on seeking us out or attacking—just gives the impression of a true husk.
m200562.つまり、もうひとつの世界にも、\n何らかの文明が存在している可能性が高いです。: In other words, there's a high chance another civilization exists in that world.
m200562.では次にエフトラさんズ、\n向こうの世界の調査報告をお願いしまーす。: Next up, Ephtra and Chi, please give us your report on the other world.
m200562.ところで、あなたの名前は？: By the way, what's your name?
m200562.どちらもでないです！\n――トラム様の仲間の方々ということは、\nつまり、皆さま: ???: Neither! —Since you're allies of Tram, that means you're all from another world, right?
m200562.なんか変なのいましたよね……。\nうろうろしてるやつ。: There was something odd there… a wandering thing.
m200562.なんでこの王子サマはやる気満々なんだ？: Why are you so eager, Prince?
m200562.はっ、申し遅れました！\n遺物拾い――スカベンジャーのプリヤンカです！: Ah, sorry for the late intro! I'm Priyanka the Scavenger, collector of artifacts…
m200562.はっ、詳しい話はあとでしますから！\n今は一刻も早く、襲撃にあったことを里に伝え: ???: Yeah, I'll give you the details later! Right now we need to tell the village about the raid as quickly as possible!
m200562.ははっ、それ以外でな。: Ha, as long as it's not that.
m200562.まぁ、言って聞くような奴じゃねぇか……。: Well, you're the type who says it and then does it, huh…
m200562.まずはギルガメッシュと、\nモードリオンによって開かれた、謎の門の現状だね。: First, the current state of the mysterious gate opened by Gilgamesh and Modrion.
m200562.もうひとつの世界に、ばばんと行ってみましょー。: Let's head straight into that other world, shall we?
m200562.よって、これまで同様小規模部隊で、\nしかし長期の調査を継続するために、\n精鋭: Thus, as before, we'll send a small elite unit for a prolonged investigation, but—
m200562.よって、調査は非常に難航していますが……。\n終焉要塞ゼウスの同型と思われる遺跡: Consequently, the investigation is extremely challenging, but we've found ruins that appear to be the same type as the End Fortress Zeus, and signs of some excavation.
m200562.アトナテスと違って、あいつはまだまだ、\n独り立ちできてねぇからなぁ。: Unlike Atnates, he's still not ready to stand on his own.
m200562.ガルヴェインは肉大盛りね。: Galwain, give me a big serving of meat.
m200562.モードリオンの相手をするのに困ってるんだが――: I'm having trouble dealing with Modrión—
m200562.一度面倒見るって決めたからな。\nあいつが助けを求めた時には、\nちゃんと手を貸: I decided I'd look after him once. When he calls for help, I want to be there to lend a hand.
m200562.世界創世の頃に遡れば……？\n超古代文明が幾度も滅ぶより以前の――: If we go back to the time of creation… before the ancient civilizations fell repeatedly—
m200562.人なんて、どう変わるか分からんものさ。: People are unpredictable; you never know how they'll change.
m200562.今もあの門は安定してるし、\n何度か侵入を試みたけど、\n必ず同じ地点に到達でき: The gate remains stable, and though we've tried to breach it several times, we always end up at the same spot.
m200562.仮称「神のなれはて」ね。\n神の楔を作り出す力を失った神――\nつまり私たち亜神: We've dubbed it the “God's Remnant.” It's a deity that's lost the power to forge divine wedges—essentially a shell of a god, different even from us demigods.
m200562.何よりも、誰もそばにいない状態で、\nあいつがぶっ壊れちまうのは、良くないだろ。: More than anything, it'd be terrible if he snapped when he's got no one around.

m200562.千年戦争で負った傷により、\n王国の建国後まもなく、若くして亡くなった……。: …due to wounds… after the kingdom's founding… he died young…

m200562.場合によっては、向こう側の、\n国家規模の文明と接触する可能性もある。\n中継な: In some cases we might even make contact with a nation-scale civilization on the other side. It's an advantage that the Prince can decide without any relay.
m200562.少なくとも対話可能で、倫理観も僕らと近そうだ。: At least we can talk to them, and their morals seem close to ours.

m200562.王子、一応、念のために言っておくが……。\nこの調査はどう考えても危険なんだぞ？: Prince, just so you know… this mission is dangerous, no matter how you look at it.
m200562.王子、提案だが、\n彼女の里へ行ってみないか。: Prince, I have a suggestion—how about we visit her village?
m200562.確かに、三つ目の種族とやらに接触するより、\n先にその里へ行った方が良さそうだな: Indeed, it'd be better to go to that village first rather than dealing with the third race directly.
m200562.私のような亜神だって、\nその当時のことは全く記憶できていないし……。: Even I, a demigod, have no memory of that era…
m200562.襲撃、ということは、\n君らは何らかの勢力と敵対しているんだな？\n魔物か？ 神: A raid, huh—so you're at odds with some force? Monsters? Or perhaps those empty-shell beings that call themselves gods?
m200562.野菜も大盛りにしておいたわ。: I've piled on extra veggies, too.
m200562.（なんで私たちの戦友って、\nこういうところで融通がきかない人ばかりなんですかね:
(Why are all our comrades so inflexible in places like this…
I wonder…)
m200562.（イメージどおりの英傑って、実在するんだなぁ）: (So the heroic type I imagined really does exist…)

m300193.――あ、あった！\nね、王子？ 言った通りでしょ？:
There—found it!
Right, Prince? Just like I said.
m300193.――あ、いました。\n王子様、天使たちです。: ―― There it is. Prince, the angels have arrived.
m300193.――お疲れ様です、皆さん。\nケイティさんも、臨時講師お疲れ様です。: “—Good work, everyone. Katie, thanks for stepping in as a temporary instructor.”
m300193.――そこまで！\nご協力ありがとうございます、王子。\n皆さんもお疲れさまでした: “—That's enough! Thank you for your cooperation, Prince. Everyone, good job.”
m300193.――とか言って、本当は嬉しいくせに。\n朝礼台に上ると途端に顔つきが変わるもんな: “—You say that, but you're actually happy. The moment you step onto the podium your expression changes.”
m300193.――グレン。それが俺の名だ。\n見ての通りの風来坊だが、腕にはそれなりに覚えがあ: —Guren. That's my name. I may look like a wandering drifter, but I've got my share of skill with my arms. If you'd like, I could lend you my strength in battle.
m300193.――セフィーレ様、神獣の卵を発見いたしました。: ―― Lady Sephire, we've found the divine beast's egg.
m300193.――セフィーレ様。\n先ほどから捜索を続けておりますが、\n目下のところ神獣の卵: ―― Lady Sephire. We've been searching ever since, but so far we haven't located the divine beast's egg.
m300193.――ッ！\nあれは、確か魔王親衛隊の――:
Whoa!
That's definitely a member of the Demon King's elite guard—
m300193.――下がってなさい、博士。\n野蛮な人間たちにワタシたちゴブリンの\n崇高なる美: —Stand down, Doctor. Barbaric humans could never grasp the lofty aesthetic sense of us goblins.
m300193.――勇猛ナル魔王軍の戦士達ヨ！\n己ガ武を存分に振ルイ、以て魔王様への忠誠を示セ:
Brave warriors of the Demon King's army!
Wield your might to the fullest and show your loyalty to the Demon Lord!
m300193.――待って、みんな。なにか聞こえる。\nこれは……銃声？: —Hold on, everyone. I hear something. Is that… gunfire?
m300193.――王子、天使たちが向かってきます。\n急ぎ戦闘のご準備を。: ―― Prince, the angels are on their way. Prepare for battle immediately.
m300193.――王子、気をつけて。\nセフィーレが祈りの体勢に入った。\nこのままだと攻撃し: ―― Prince, be careful. Sephire's entered her prayer stance. If we attack now, she'll just heal right away.
m300193.――竜将クロコだ。\n覚えておいてもらオウ。:
I am Dragon General Croco.
Remember that.
m300193.――見つけたわよ、鬼刃衆！\n黙っていなくなったと思ったら、\nやっぱりこんなこ: ——Found you, Oni Blade Squad! I thought you'd gone silent, but it turned out just like this!
m300193.…………思い出したぜ。\nあんた、世界を救うっつう理想のために\n世界中を飛び回: …I just remembered. You're the Prince everyone's talking about, the one who flies around the world to fulfill that ideal of saving it, right?
m300193.……『クイーン様』？\nでは、ゴブリン博士の傍にいるのは……！: …“Queen”? Then the one beside the Goblin Doctor must be…!
m300193.……いや、あれはレイスというアンデッドの魔物だ。\n生者を冥府へと導こうとする死:
…No, that's a wraith, an undead creature.
It's a vengeful spirit trying to lead the living to the underworld.
m300193.……うぉぉぉおおおッ！！！\nこれだ、これぞ魔神フェネクスの再生能力……！\n見: ...Wooooooo!!! This is it—Phenix's regeneration! Look, the cut on my finger from yesterday is healed!
m300193.……え、先生姿が様になっている？\nも、もう……王子までそんなことを……。: “…Huh, does the professor look all proper now? …Gee, even the Prince is saying that…”
m300193.……おい、あんたら何者だ？\n興味本位で戦場に足突っ込むたぁ、感心しねェな？: …Hey, who are you guys? You just waltz onto a battlefield out of curiosity—nothing to be impressed by.
m300193.……そうだ。\nもし宜しければ、軽くお手合わせ願えませんか。\n生徒たちへの指導: “…Right. If you don't mind, could we have a quick spar? I'd like to see how my teaching is paying off.”
m300193.……そうですね。\n王子や皆さんにそう仰っていただけるのでしたら。: …Indeed. If the Prince and everyone else say so.
m300193.……だとすると、まずいかもしれない。\n急に撤退したのは、目的を達したからかも…: …If that's true, it could be trouble. Their sudden retreat might mean they got what they wanted…
m300193.……でも、さっきのクロコって人、\nまだ本気を出してないみたいだったよ。: …But that Croco earlier didn't seem to have shown his full power yet.
m300193.……ふぅ。なんとか一件落着ですね。\n前にも似たようなことがあったような気がしま: …phew. Looks like we finally wrapped that up. I feel like we've dealt with something similar before.
m300193.……ふぅ。なんとか退治できましたね。\nしかし、なぜレイスが現れるようになったの:
…Phew. We managed to take it down.
But why are wraiths appearing now?
m300193.……ほう、助太刀してくれるってのか。\nま、あんたらが加わっても\n多勢に無勢に: …Oh? You're offering to lend a hand. Well, even with you joining, it won't change the fact that we're outnumbered.
m300193.……ま、まぁ、\nとにかくレイスは危険な敵だということが判りました。\n今後も十:
…Well, anyway, we've learned that wraiths are dangerous foes.
Let's stay on our guard from now on.
m300193.……まったく。\n鬼刃衆、拾い食いはダメでしょう？: ...Honestly. Oni Blade Squad, no snacking on leftovers, okay?
m300193.……みんなこう言ってることだし、\n今後もたまには教壇に立ったらいいんじゃないか: “…Everyone's saying that, so maybe you should stand at the podium more often, huh, Professor Katie?”
m300193.……もう嗅ぎつけてきましたか。\nですが、我々の目的を阻ませるわけにはいきません: …You've already sniffed it out, I see. Still, we can't let anything stand in the way of our goal.
m300193.……わかっています。\nですが、いましばらく捜索を続行してください。: …I understand. Continue the search for a while longer.
m300193.……んぉぉぉおおおっ！ せ、拙者もです！\n鉛のようだった肩こりがまるで羽になっ: ...Nnnooo! Me too! The heaviness in my shoulders feels like feathers!
m300193.……ウッ！？ \nハァ、ハァッ……ですが、\nなぜか目まいと息切れが……。: ...Ugh!? Hah, hah... but I'm getting dizzy and out of breath...
m300193.……チッ。\n鬼どもめ、倒した傍から湧いてきやがって……。: …Tch. Those demons, popping up again right after we took them down…
m300193.……ハァ、ハァ。\nや、やっと撒いたか？: “…Hah, hah. Did you finally scatter them?”
m300193.……フン、口ほどにもネェ野郎だゼ。: Hmph, you're not even worth a mouthful.
m300193.……名乗るほどのモンじゃねえさ。\nじゃあ、また縁があればな。: …I'm not the type to introduce myself. Well then, if our paths cross again…
m300193.……大変そうですね。\n先生のお仕事というのは。: …That sounds tough. Being a teacher, I mean.
m300193.……少し静かになっテもらオウカ。: Quiet down a bit, will you?
m300193.……片付いたみてえだな。\nありがとよ、助かったぜ。: …Looks like it's all cleared up. Thanks for the help.
m300193.……理由？ そんなの決まってるじゃない。\n死の淵から蘇った新しいワタシを見ても: …Reason? That's obvious. I'm here to show you the new me, reborn from the brink of death.
m300193.……私もできることがあれば\n微力ながらお手伝いをさせていただく所存です。\n今: …If there's anything I can do, I'm prepared to help in any small way I can. Let's continue to boost the academy together.
m300193.……私を裏切ったらどうなるか、\nわかっているでしょうね、王子？: …You know what would happen if you betrayed me, don't you, Prince?
m300193.……端から村を救いに来たってわけか。\n物好きなヤツらもいたもんだ。: …So you came to save the village from the start. You're a strange bunch.
m300193.……誰だか知らんガ、言葉は慎メ。\n私は自らの意志で此処に来たノダ。\n英雄と名:
I don't know who you are, so keep your words in check.
I came here of my own accord, to clash with the army of the famed Hero Prince.
m300193.『フェネクス』と聞こえましたから、\nおそらくまた魔神の残片を飲んでしまったので: I heard "Phenix," so you probably drank another fragment of the demon god again. You lot never learn...
m300193.あぁっ！\n王子、オークさんたちがこっちに向かってきます！:
Ah!
Prince, the Orcs are heading this way!
m300193.あの……気のせいかもしれませんが、\nさっき天使たちが『神獣の卵』と言っていたよ: Um… maybe I'm imagining it, but the angels just now were talking about a “divine beast's egg”…
m300193.あら、そんなの簡単よ。\n怨霊が現れる理由なんて、ひとつしかないわ。:
Oh, that's simple.
There's only one reason a vengeful spirit shows up.
m300193.あら、怖がらせてなんかないわ。\n釘を刺しただけよ。ね、王子？:
Oh, I wasn't trying to frighten anyone.
I just stuck a nail in. Right, Prince?
m300193.ありがとうございます、王子。\n……それでは生徒の皆さん、\n私が指示する通りに: “Thank you, Prince. …Alright, everyone, move exactly as I command.”
m300193.ありがとよ。\nそんじゃ、今後もよろしく頼むぜ。: Thanks. Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
m300193.あれは――！\n王子、向こうに一人で鬼と戦っている人が！: That…! Prince, there's someone over there fighting demons alone!
m300193.いえ、こちらこそお礼を言わせてください。\n先ほどは助かりました。ええと……。: No, thank you. We're the ones who should be grateful. You saved us earlier. Um…
m300193.いずれまた戦おウ。\n暫し、さらばダ。:
We'll meet again on the battlefield.
Until then, farewell.
m300193.うおおおおおおおっ！！\n同胞よ、先陣を切れ！\n王子の首級はオレたちの手で挙げ:
Uooooooo!!
Comrades, lead the charge!
We'll cut off the Prince's head with our own hands!
m300193.うっ……鬼刃姫様。\n面目ありませぬ……。: Ugh... Princess Kibahime. I have no excuse...
m300193.うむ、あっぱれな飲みっぷりだ。\nそれではこちらも……ゴクリ、ゴクリ……。: Indeed, impressive drinking technique. Here we go too... *gulp* *gulp*.
m300193.ええ……それに、魔王親衛隊の将が\n自ら隊を率いて物質界に現れるとは……。: Yeah… and for a commander of the Demon King's elite guard to lead his own troops into the material world…
m300193.ええ……ゴブリン博士の技術力は\n日増しに高まっているようですね。: Indeed... Goblin Doctor's skill keeps improving every day.
m300193.ええ。昨日の夜、散歩をしていたら見つけたの。\nそう、ちょうどあの墓碑のあたりで:
Yes. I found it while taking a walk last night.
Right around that tombstone... hehe.
m300193.ええっ！？\nじゃあ、どうすれば……。: What!? Then what should we do…?
m300193.おおぉっ！\nでは、その御手に持ちたるは……。: Oh wow! Then, what we hold in our hands is...
m300193.が、ウロウロしてる鬼の娘どもには気をつけな。\nあのどデカい金棒の一撃は痛いなん: But watch out for those wandering demon girls. Their massive iron clubs don't just hurt—they'll sweep everyone around them with a single swing.
m300193.こらこら、いたずらに人を怖がらせるものじゃない。: Hey now, don't go scaring people for fun.
m300193.さぁて……覚悟なさい、人間たち！\nワタシの快気祝いに相応しい、\n無様な踊りを: Now then… prepare yourselves, humans! I'll give you a pitiful dance befitting my recovery celebration!
m300193.さすれば今後は我らが主、鬼刃姫様の心労も除かれよう。\nあの御方は常に我々を気に: Then we can relieve our lord, Princess Kibahime, of her worries. She's always been looking out for us, after all.
m300193.しかし、冷静に考えてみると\nよくそう何度も魔神の残片を見つけられるものだな。: But thinking about it calmly, it's amazing how often they manage to find fragments of the demon god.

I've heard those fishfolk are trying to summon a dragon.

m400449.……あぁんもう！ 泣いてる場合じゃないよね！\nしっかりしなきゃ！: Ah, stop it! This isn't the time to be crying! I have to pull myself together!

Please help us defeat the pirates…!

Please hear us out!

It's still a fight between sailors and pirates…
m920020.この荒れよう、どうやら何者かに\n襲撃されたようですね。: Looks like this devastation was attacked by someone.
m920020.これで終わったんですね。\nあの、ありがとうございます、\nです。:
So that's it, huh?
Um, thank you,
for everything.
m920020.これで魔物はいなくなったです！: With that, the monsters are gone!
m920020.これは一筋縄ではいかないようですね。: This won't be a simple affair.
m920020.これまで敵同士だったんです。\n信じあうことができないのも無理ないですね。\nで:
We've been enemies all this time. No wonder we can't trust each other.
But that weakness was exploited…
m920020.こんな海の片隅で泣き言言ったところで\n誰かが助けてくれるわけねぇだろ！\n甘え:
Crying in a corner of the sea won't get anyone to rescue you!
Stop being a wimp!
m920020.こんにちは王子。\n私はミネルバ。海賊よ。\nちょっと私も混ぜていただいていいか:
Good day, Prince.
I am Minerva. A pirate.
May I join in as well?
m920020.さっき見たと思いますが、あの人が私たちの\n宿敵である海賊のリーダー、ベアトリカ: You probably saw earlier, that person is Beatrice, the leader of the pirates—our arch-enemy.
m920020.しかし、海賊たちはどこに消えたのでしょう。\n兵士からの報告によると被害は大きく:
But where did the pirates disappear to?
According to the soldier's report, the damage was severe, and Beatrica's fate is unknown.
m920020.それがどこにも見当たらないんです。\nもしかして、全滅したんでしょうか……。:
We can't find them anywhere.
Did they all get wiped out…?
m920020.それにしても、\n私の手助けを拒んでおきながら\nあなたたちを信用するなんて……: Even after refusing my aid, you still trusted them… .
m920020.それよりも聞きたいことがあります。\nなぜあなた方は魔物と手を結んだのですか。:
More importantly, I have a question.
Why did you ally with the monsters?
m920020.そんな馬鹿なことがあるか。むしろ逆だ！\n水兵どもが魔物をけしかけて\n俺たちの:
That's nonsense. It's the other way around!
The sailors provoked the monsters and attacked our ship.
m920020.そんな！ まっすぐこちらに向かってくる！？: No way! They're heading straight for us!?
m920020.だけど、襲撃のせいで、もう水兵は数名しかいなくて……。\n残っている私以外の水兵:
However, because of the raid, only a few sailors remain…
Everyone else besides me is non-combatant, so honestly the upcoming battle will be tough.
m920020.だけど魔物がでてからは、ひとまず停戦しようって\n話になったんですけど……。: But when the monsters appeared, we agreed to a temporary cease-fire…
m920020.ちっ。急いで船を岸に寄せろ！\n野郎ども、手を貸してやれ。:
Damn it. Get the ship to shore fast!
You bastards, lend a hand.
m920020.ちゃんと天国に行ってくださいね。\n……でも悪い人たちだから天国には\nいけない:
Please go to heaven properly.
…But maybe the bad ones can't get there.
m920020.ったく……。\n危なっかしくて見てらんねぇ。:
Good grief….
It was too dangerous to watch.
m920020.ですが実際に私たちは水兵たちと共にいましたが\n水兵たちも魔物の襲撃を受けました: But actually we were with the sailors, and they were also attacked by monsters. It looked like they were supporting the pirates.
m920020.でも、これでやっと戦いが終わったです……。\n水兵のみんなも、きっと喜んでくれま:
But now the battle's finally over…
The sailors will surely be happy!
m920020.どうやら今はこちらを片付けた方が良いようです。\n王子、参りましょう！: It seems we should deal with them now. Prince, let's go!
m920020.どうやら侵入を防ぐにはわずかなポイントを\n守るしかないようです。: It seems the only way to stop the intrusion is to hold a few key points.
m920020.どちらにしても、早急に応戦したほうが\nよさそうですね。: Either way, we should respond quickly.
m920020.なので、犯人は考えるまでもなかったんです。\n……私たちは海賊を許さないです。:
So it was obvious who the culprit was.
…We won't forgive the pirates.
m920020.なんか水兵の味方をするって感じで\n俺らだけを襲ったことだって何度もあったし。\: They even turned on us alone, like they were siding with the sailors—happened countless times. Damn those sailors…!
m920020.めんどくせぇが、なんかあったら呼べ。\nそんときゃ助けてやるからよ。:
It's a pain, but call me if anything comes up.
I'll help you then.
m920020.もしかしてベアトリカさんを\n助けに来たのですか？: Did you come to rescue Beatrica-san?
m920020.やっと片付いたか。\nさて、これで邪魔者はいなくなった。\nお前らとも決着をつけ:
Finally cleared it up.
Now there's no one left to bother us.
Let's settle this with you too!
m920020.やっぱり海賊は勝つためなら\n手段を選ばないんですね……。\nひどいですっ！:
So they'll use any means to win…
How terrible!
m920020.わざわざ来てもらったのにごめんなさい。\nでも、今この戦いを止めるわけにはいかな:
I'm sorry you had to come all this way.
But we can't just stop this fight now!
m920020.われわれは海賊ではありません。\nこの争いを止めるためにやってきました。\n他の:
We are not pirates.
We've come to end this conflict.
Where are the other sailors?
m920020.わわっ！ 誰ですかあなたたちは？ \nまさか海賊ですか！？: Whoa! Who are you? Are you pirates!?
m920020.ギョギョ……。\nこのまま終わってたまるか。\n我らにも誇りがある。:
Gyo-gyo…
We can't just let it end like this.
We have pride too.
m920020.ギョギョギョ……。馬鹿な人間め。\nもう隠れる必要もない。\n全軍で叩きのめして:
Gyo-gyo-gyo… You foolish humans.
No need to hide any longer.
We'll crush you with our whole army!
m920020.ギョー！\nこんな強い人間がいたなんて……。:
Gyo!
I never thought there were humans this strong…
m920020.チッ。おい、俺の側から離れんな！\nじたばた暴れられても面倒だからな。\nしかた:
Tch. Hey, don't stray from my side!
If you start flailing around it'll be a hassle.
Fine, I'll protect you!
m920020.ハッ。水兵だって同じようなもんだろ。\n自分たちだけいい子ちゃんぶってんじゃねぇ:
Hah. Sailors are the same, aren't they?
Don't act all pure.
m920020.一応、こちらにも注意したほうが\n良いかもしれません。: It might be wise to stay on guard here too.
m920020.今、人間同士が争っている場合では\nありません。\nすぐに止めさせないと。:
Now is not the time for humans to be fighting each other.
We have to stop this right away.
m920020.俺たちだって逃げも隠れもしねぇ……。: We're not running or hiding either…
m920020.俺たちのアジトで待っている。\nそこで決着をつけようじゃねぇかってな。:
We'll wait at our hideout.
Let's settle this there.
m920020.停戦協定の日、停泊していた私たちの船は\n攻撃されました。: On the day of the cease-fire, our ship, which was anchored, was attacked.
m920020.助ける気がないのなら、\nあなたは何をしにここへ……。: If you have no intention to help, then what are you doing here…?
m920020.勘違いしないで。\n海賊同士は仲間じゃないのよ。\nむしろライバルだわ。:
Don't get the wrong idea.
Pirates aren't friends.
They're rivals, actually.
m920020.協定を結ぼうとした島には、私たち水兵と\n相手の海賊しかいなかったんです。: The island where we were supposed to sign the treaty had only us sailors and the opposing pirates.
m920020.同胞たちに連絡を。\n人間どもを皆殺しにするのだ……。:
Contact our comrades.
Kill all the humans…
m920020.報告！ この先で水兵と海賊が\n交戦中です！: Report! Sailors and pirates are engaging in combat ahead!
m920020.報告！ どうやら海賊はどこかに向かって\n引き上げを開始しているようです。: Report! It looks like the pirates have started withdrawing somewhere.
m920020.報告！ 魔物の出現を確認！\nこちらに攻め込んできています！:
Report! Monster activity confirmed!
They're advancing toward us!
m920020.大変です！\n船底に穴が……！\n浸水しています！:
This is terrible!
There's a hole in the hull…!
We're taking on water!
m920020.彼女に力を貸し、この戦いを\n終わらせましょう！: Let's lend her our strength and end this fight!
m920020.情けねぇ声出すんじゃねぇよ。\n最後まで戦え！: Don't whine, you hear? Fight till the end!
m920020.手助けする理由もなければ\n助けてもらいたいとも思わない。\nとくにあの娘なら尚:
I have no reason to help, nor do I want any help.
Especially not from that girl.
m920020.抜かれぬように注意してください！: Be careful not to let them slip away!
m920020.改めまして、さっきは手を貸してくれて\nありがとうございました！\n私は水兵のマ:
First of all, thank you for lending a hand earlier.
Thank you! I'm Marie, a sailor.
m920020.次で海賊との決着をつけるです……！: Next, we'll settle things with the pirates…!
m920020.水兵さんから聞いた話では\n海賊が魔物と手を組んで休戦協定の日に\n水兵の船を沈: From what the sailors told me, the pirates teamed up with the monsters and sank the sailors' ship on the truce day…
m920020.水兵と戦ってるときとか、\n急に魔物が現れたんスよ。: When we were fighting the sailors, monsters would suddenly appear.
m920020.決まっているでしょう。\nベアトリカの誇りを傷つけた者に\nお仕置きするためよ。:
It's obvious.
I'm here to punish anyone who tarnished Beatrica's pride.
m920020.海賊が魔物と手を組むなんて！: The pirates teaming up with monsters!
m920020.海賊たちには恨みしかないですが\nお花くらいは供えてあげるです。: I've got nothing but a grudge against the pirates, but I'll at least offer them some flowers.
m920020.海賊たちのリーダーです。\nただ見た目が女だからって\n油断しちゃだめです。:
He's the leader of the pirates.
But don't let your guard down just because he looks like a woman.
m920020.海賊には攻撃しないなんて……。\nまさか海賊が魔物と手を組んで！？ \nそんなぁ:
Not attacking the pirates…
Could the pirates have teamed up with the monsters!?
That can't be…
m920020.海賊も水兵もお互いを疑うことしか\nしらないマヌケぞろい……、\nギョギョ！ 殺:
Pirates and sailors only know how to distrust each other—a bunch of idiots…
Gyo-gyo! Don't kill me—!
m920020.王子、多分そろそろ大将のベアトリカだけじゃ\nなくって、幹部の人たちとかも出てく: Prince, soon not only General Beatrice but also the other officers might appear.
m920020.王子、油断なさらないよう、\nお気を付けください。: Prince, please be careful not to let your guard down.
m920020.王子、海賊が再び攻めてきたようです！\n彼女の話……。もし本当なら、海賊を\n止:
Prince, it seems the pirates are attacking again!
Her story… If it's true, we have to stop them.
m920020.王子、海賊です！\nどうやら魔物たちと戦っているようですが……。\nいかがいたし: Prince, pirates! It looks like they're fighting the monsters… What shall we do?
m920020.王子と海賊、世間的にゃ善と悪だが、\n手を組むのも、悪くねぇだろ？: The world sees the Prince and pirates as good and evil, but teaming up isn't so bad, right?
m920020.私たちは長年、領海争いが絶えなくて\n敵対関係にあるんです。: We've been at odds for years over territorial waters.
m920020.私を差し置いても王子を信用したのよ？\nあまり泣かせるようなことはしないことね。: You trusted the Prince over me, huh? Don't make me cause you any more tears.
m920020.船長、やめてくださいよ！\nあ、すいません。\nとりあえず助けてください！:
Captain, please stop!
Ah, sorry.
Just… help us out for now!
m920020.誰だてめぇらは！\n水兵の仲間か？\nかまわねぇ、やっちまえ！:
Who the hell are you!
Friends of the sailors?
Fine, I don't care—let's kill 'em!
m920020.魔物と仲間割れでもしたんですか？: Did you have a falling out with the monsters?
m920020.魔物には私も色々とお世話になっているから、\nお返しにきたの。: I've been indebted to the monsters, so I'm here to repay them.
m920020.魔物の生き残りはこの先のようね……。\nそろそろこちらにも向ってくるかもしれない:
The monsters' survivors will appear later….
They might start heading this way soon.

m920069.(何てことだ……私の狙撃のせいで、\n村が襲われただなんて……): (What a disaster… because of my sniping, the village was attacked…)
m920069.――うぐぁあッッ！！\nみ、見事だ、人間の勇者よ……。\nオレを打ち負かすとは…:
—Ughaa!!
Marvelous, human hero… To defeat me… impressive…
m920069.――おぉ？ まだ人間が残っていたか！\nこのあたりにはもう人間は残っていないと\: ――Oh? There are still humans left! I thought none remained around here, but this is lucky!
m920069.――はぁ、はぁ……ほ、報告ッ！\nお、オークの大部隊が、\nジャングルの奥地に突:
Haa… haa… R-report!
A massive orc detachment just appeared deep in the jungle!
m920069.――ッ！？\nこ、こんな時にゴブリンだと！？\n俺の命運も、ここまでかもしれない:
—!?
G-goblin at a time like this!?
My fate might end here…
m920069.――ッ！？\n銃撃……だと？\n誰だ卑怯な手で戦場を汚す輩は！？: ――! Gunfire… huh? Who's the coward using such dirty tactics on the battlefield!?
m920069.――ッ！？ こ、こちらを見ています。\nどうやら言葉に偽りはないようですね……。: ——! They're… looking right at us. Seems their words aren't false… Prince, stay on guard and approach the Orcs.
m920069.――少し会わない間に、\n随分と優しい目をするように\nなったのですね、レーゼル: ???: —It seems that during our brief separation, you've grown quite a gentle gaze, Rösel.
m920069.――強き者たちよ！\n隠れていないで、オレの前に出てくるのだ！\nそこにいるのは: ——Strong ones! Stop hiding and step before me! I know you're there.
m920069.――王子、レーゼルさんを見つけました！\nどうやらまた単身で\nオークと戦うつも:
――Prince, we've found Rösel!
It seems she's planning to go off alone against the orcs again!
m920069.――王子！\nあそこを見て！ レーゼルだ！\n早く助けに行こう！: ――Prince! Look over there! It's Rösel! Let's hurry to help!
m920069.――王子！\n勝利を喜んでる余裕はないぞ！\nすぐに進軍を再開するんだ！: ――Prince! There's no time to celebrate victory! We must resume the march at once!
m920069.――王子！ ここだよ！\n帝国兵がオークから逃げる為に、\nこの洞窟に入っていく:
—Prince! It's here!
I saw the Imperial troops fleeing the Orcs and heading into this cave!
m920069.――王子！！ こっちだよ！\n森にオークの大群が押し寄せてきたんだ！\n本格的に: —Prince!! Over here! A massive Orc horde is sweeping into the forest! They've clearly started a full-scale invasion of the surface.
m920069.…………ようやく終わったな。\n他のオーク達も、帝国軍の攻勢によって\nほとんど:
………Finally it's over.
It seems the other Orcs, pressed by the Imperial forces, have mostly retreated back to the demon realm.
m920069.……だが、これからも貴方達が\n困った時には駆けつけるつもりでいる。\n私の力が: …but whenever you're in trouble, I'll still rush to your aid. If you need my strength, just call…
m920069.……な、なぜだ？\nさっきまで無かった筈の岩が道を塞いでる……。\nこの経路から:
…W-why?
A rock that wasn't there a moment ago is now blocking the path…
Looks like we can't get out of the cave this way…
m920069.……わ、悪かったよ。\nそうとは知らず、軽口を叩いちまった……。: …I—I'm sorry. I didn't know that, and I said something careless…
m920069.……ギャギャッ！\nオレタチガ運ンダ岩デ、\n人間、困ッテル、迷ッテル、弱ッテル:
…Gyahaha!
We've got a lucky rock, humans are stuck, lost, weak!
m920069.……一緒に来てくれる？\nうん、それでこそ王子だよね！\nそうと決まれば、すぐに: …Will you come with me? Yeah, that's what a prince does! If that's decided, let's go after her right away!
m920069.……助けてくれて、ありがとう。\n貴方達が来なかったら、\nゴブリン達にやられて:
…Thanks for the rescue.
If you hadn't come, we'd have been taken down by the goblins…
m920069.……彼女は白の帝国の兵士だよ。\n仲間との会話を聞いてたけど、\nレーゼルって呼: …She's a soldier of the White Empire. I heard her talking with her comrades, and they called her Rezel.
m920069.……王子。\nオーク軍本隊は、予想をはるかに超える戦力を\n有しているようです。:
…Prince.
The main Orc army has far exceeded our expectations in strength. Shall we retreat…?
m920069.……貴方達は、何者なんだ？\nまさか……我々を助けてくれるというのか！？:
…Who are you?
Could it be… you're here to help us!?
m920069.……邪魔を、しないでくれ……。\n私はまだ……戦える。: …Don't… get in my way… I can still… fight.
m920069.あ、あの……。\nレーゼルさんは、どうなさるつもりですか？: Uh, um… what will Rösel do?
m920069.あんたら帝国兵は\n長い間この森を守ってくれてただろ？\nまあ、恩返しみたいなも: You Imperial soldiers have been protecting this forest for ages, right? Well, consider this a repayment.
m920069.いいか、王子……。\n其方はこのオレが倒すのだ。\nオレ以外のオークに負けるなど:
Listen, Prince…
You'll have to take me down yourself.
I won't tolerate losing to any other Orc.
m920069.いいぞ……。\nこの地は死んでいった者達の\n怨念に満ちている……。: Good… This land is saturated with the grudges of the dead…
m920069.え、エリアス！？\nなぜ帝国の治癒士がこんな場所に……？\nまさか……ついに、援: E—Elias!? Why is the Empire's healer here…? Could it be… the reinforcements have finally arrived!?
m920069.ええ。それに、魔神ビフロンスは、\nやはり彼らの背後に\n潜んでいるようですね…: Indeed. And it seems the demon god Bifrons is still lurking behind them…
m920069.えっと、エリアスさん……でしたよね？\nご助力いただき、ありがとうございます。\: Um, you're Elias, right? Thank you for your help. Will you keep fighting the Orcs with us?
m920069.え！？ あ、あの……レーゼルさん！？\n――きゃぁっ！？ あの……きゅ、急に\n:
Wh—! Um… Rösel?!
—Kyaa! Um… I- it's… embarrassing when you suddenly hug me…
m920069.お、おい……本当にあの\n大部隊と戦うのかよぉ……？\nやっぱり引き返さねえか？: Hey… seriously… are we really going to take on that massive force? Should we turn back after all?
m920069.お、おいっ……！\nって、行っちまったな……。\n一体あいつは何者だったんだ？: H-hey…! She's gone… Who on earth was that?
m920069.お、おい！ そこのあんた。\nまさか、まだ戦う気なのか！？\n後は俺達に任せてと: Hey, you there! You're still planning to fight?! Leave the rest to us and get out of here quickly!
m920069.おいおい……強いヤツと戦いたいが為に、\nこれだけの戦火を森にぶちまけたってのか: Hey, hey… you want to fight a strong guy, so you dump this whole war into the forest? You're insane… It's too dangerous to just leave it.
m920069.おそらく先ほどあたし達が倒したのは、\n偵察か先遣隊に過ぎなかったという訳か。\:
It means what we just took down was probably just a scouting party or vanguard.
What now… fleeing is an option, you know?
m920069.お待たせして、本当にすみませんでした。\n既に、後陣の準備は完了しています。\n: Sorry to keep you waiting. The rear camp is already set up. We'll resume the Imperial assault on the Orcs now!
m920069.くそ……オークの猛攻をしのぐ為に\nこの洞窟に身を潜めたというのに、\n出口を見: Damn… We hid in this cave to weather the Orcs' fierce attack, and now we've lost the exit—no chance for a counter-attack.
m920069.くそ、まさか誘導されていたとは……。\nそれにあのオーク、明らかに他とは威圧感が: Damn, I never thought we'd be led like this… And that Orc, his presence is clearly more intimidating than the others… He's definitely a formidable foe.
m920069.ここまで来て、レーゼルさんを\n放っておくことはできませんね。\n王子、彼女を追: We can't just leave Rösel behind after coming this far. Prince, let's go after her!
m920069.このままあたしは彼女を追いかけるけど、\n王子はどうする……？: I could keep chasing after her, but what will you do, Prince…?
m920069.この一撃でトドメだ、帝国の兵士よ。\n独りになっても、\n最期まで戦うその気高さ: This blow will be the finishing strike, Imperial soldier. Even if you're alone, your noble resolve to fight till the end was beautiful.
m920069.この先にある村を\nオークの軍団が襲撃してるようなんだ！\n頼む、急いでくれ！: A village ahead is being raided by an Orc legion! Please, hurry!
m920069.これだけ多くの不死者を作っても\nまだ尽きることのない怨み辛み……。\nこれなら: Even after raising so many undead, the resentment never runs out… With this, I could forge the ultimate undead legion—
m920069.これでジャングルの中の狙撃から\n安心して身を守ることが出来るだろう。: Now we can defend ourselves safely from those jungle snipers.
m920069.ご、ごめん……嬉しくてつい……。\nその……力を貸してくれてありがとう。\n本当:
I-I'm sorry… I got carried away with excitement…
Thank you for lending me your strength.
I really ended up causing you trouble…
m920069.さあ行け！\nやつらに、死よりも恐ろしい\n恐怖を味わわせてやるのだ！: Now, go! Let them taste a terror more dreadful than death!
m920069.すべての魔物の掃滅を確認！\n周囲に魔物の姿はもうありません！:
All monsters have been cleared!
No sign of any creatures nearby!
m920069.すまない、もう行かなくてはいけないようだ。\nみんな、今まで本当にありがとう……: I'm sorry, I have to go now. Everyone, thank you for everything… Prince… I promise you'll come back alive.
m920069.そうですね。私達には王子と仲間がいます。\n共に対策を考えることにしましょう。\: That's right. We have the Prince and our allies. Let's figure out a plan together. Then let's return, Ehret.
m920069.そもそもオークの狙いが王子なんだ。\nここで逃げても、いつかは戦わなきゃならねえ: The Orcs are after the Prince in the first place. Even if we run now, we'll have to face them someday. So I'm coming with you, Prince.
m920069.それでは王子、帰還しましょう。\nこの度はお疲れ様でした。:
Then, Prince, let's return.
Thank you for your efforts this time.
m920069.それに……最後まで戦いたいんだ。\n独りだった私の為に力を貸してくれた、\n貴方: Besides… I want to fight to the end. I want to stand with you, who lent me strength when I was alone, and see this through.
m920069.それにしても、\nあんたその身体でよく戦いきったな。\n名前を聞かせて――: Still… you managed to fight through with that body of yours. Tell me your name—
m920069.それにしても帝国軍ってのは薄情だぜ。\n仲間ひとり置き去りにして\nみんな逃げ出: The Imperial troops are so cold-hearted. They'll leave a comrade behind and just run away.
m920069.それはまずいですね。\n王子、すぐに村へ向かいましょう！: That's terrible. Prince, let's head to the village immediately!
m920069.それは本当か！？\nついにあの王子と戦うことができるのか……。\n魔界から出向い: Is that true!? Finally we get to fight that Prince… All that effort traveling from the Demon Realm was worth it!
m920069.それ以上の死者への冒涜は、\n私達が許しません！: Any further desecration of the dead is something we won't allow!
m920069.だから魔物たちが魔界から現れた時は、\nジャングルの為に敵と戦ってくれてたんだ。: So when monsters emerged from the demon realm, those troops fought the enemies for the sake of the jungle.
m920069.だが……これで勝ったと……思うな……。: But… don't think you've won with this…
m920069.だが、オークとの戦いはまだ終わってねえ。\n戦いを生き甲斐とするオーク族の闘争本:
But the fight with the Orcs isn't over yet.
I'm constantly amazed by the Orcs' battle-lust, living for combat…
m920069.だが、見たところ貴方たちは他国の\n兵のようだが、なぜ帝国軍である\n私たちのこ: But you seem like soldiers from another nation—why did you come to help us Imperial troops…?
m920069.だがオレを倒したことで、オークの別の部族らが\n其方の強さに目をつけることだろう:
But now that I've fallen, other Orc tribes will set their sights on your strength…
Heh… the war has only just begun.
m920069.だけど、魔界からオークの大群が出現すると、\nその圧倒的な数と力に\n駐屯してい: But when a massive horde of Orcs appeared from the demon realm, their overwhelming numbers and power caused the stationed forces to collapse…
m920069.ちっ……あれはレッサーオークだな。\nオークの中でも非力で\n戦士になれなかった: Tch… those are Lesser Orcs. Even among Orcs they're weak and never became warriors.
m920069.って、ここで不安になっててもしょうがないね。\nとにかく今はリッチロードを倒せた: Well, there's no point worrying now. At least we took down the Lich Lord, so they shouldn't be able to do anything for a while!
m920069.って言っても、そんな理由なんか無くても、\nジャングルの中で誰かが困ってたら\n: Even without that reason, if someone's in trouble in the jungle, you'd think we should help, right?
m920069.で、伝令ッ！\nオークの本隊が到着した模様！\nその規模……先の部隊とは比較にな:
Hey, messenger!
It looks like the main Orc force has arrived! Their numbers… incomparable to the previous units!
m920069.でも彼女の様子は普通じゃないよ……。\nあのままじゃオークに\nやられるに決まっ: But she's not acting normal… At this rate, she's bound to get taken down by the Orcs.
m920069.と、いうわけだ……。\nすまない、最後まで共に戦うつもりでいたが、\nこのままで: …so that's that… I'm sorry—I intended to fight with you until the end, but it's clear I'd just be a hindrance now.
m920069.とはいえ、当然ゴブリンよりもはるかに強い。\nそれに、傷を負うと凶暴化するときた: Still, they're far stronger than goblins. And they get even more ferocious when wounded… You'd better watch out, Prince.
m920069.どうした、ユリアン？\nお前らしくもない。\nまさか怖じ気づいたのか？:
What's wrong, Julian? That's not like you.
Did you get scared?
m920069.どうやら、ここがオークの本陣のようだね……。\n王子、ここからは\n一瞬たりとも: Looks like this is the Orc stronghold… Prince, from here on out don't let your guard slip for even a moment…
m920069.どうやら無事に勝てたようですね。\nさすが王子です！: It looks like we won without a hitch. As expected of you, Prince!
m920069.どんな理由であれ、\nジャングルの為に戦ってくれている\nレーゼルをあたしは放っ: No matter the reason, I can't just leave Rezel fighting for the jungle!
m920069.な……なんだって……ッ！？\n大部隊って……ど、どういうことだ……？:
Wh—what…!?
A detachment… w-what does that even mean…?
m920069.ば、バカなこと言ってんじゃねえよッ！\nオークが何体こようが、俺様が王子を守って:
D-Don't say something stupid!
No matter how many Orcs come, I'll protect the Prince. Feel free to ride that big ship, Prince.
m920069.ふむ、新たな人間どもが来たか……。\nどうやら邪魔が入ったようだ。\n運がいいな: Hmm, new humans have arrived… Seems like they've gotten in the way. Lucky you, Imperial soldier.
m920069.やったぞ、みんなぁーッ！\nオーク達を倒すことができたんだ！\n私達は、ついに成:
Yes! Everyone—!
We finally took those orcs down!
We actually pulled it off—!!
m920069.やりましたね、王子。\nオークが撤退していきます。\n村を取り戻すことができまし: We did it, Prince. The Orcs are retreating. We've reclaimed the village!
m920069.やりましたね、王子！\nオーク軍が続々と退いていきます！\nこれでこの地に平穏が:
We did it, Prince!
The orc forces are falling back one after another!
Peace should return to this land now.
m920069.ようやくオレの前に姿を現したか、王子！\n其方と戦う為、あえて本陣への\n接近を: So you finally revealed yourself before me, Prince! To fight you, I deliberately let you get close to the stronghold. Come even closer.
m920069.ようやく人間の村を占領できたようだな。: Looks like we finally managed to occupy a human village.
m920069.ようやく現れたな、オーク共め……。\n帝国兵が命を削ってまで戦ったっていうなら、: At last you show up, you Orcs… If the Imperial soldiers fought to the death, then I'll give you a battle worthy of their sacrifice!
m920069.よっし、どうやらゴブリン達は\nみんな逃げていったみたいだね。\n王子、お疲れさ:
Alright, looks like all the goblins have fled.
Prince, good work!
m920069.オレは族の武勇が頂に立つオークの勇者！\n人中の勇者と称される王子に対敵せんと、: I am the Orc Hero, whose clan's valor stands at the pinnacle! I've come all the way from the demon realm to clash with the prince famed as a hero among men!
m920069.オークの動向は今後も注意が必要ですね。\nですが、帝国との共闘の末に勝ち得た\n:
We'll need to keep an eye on Orc movements going forward.
For now, we should enjoy the peace we've won in the jungle after cooperating with the Empire.
m920069.オーク！ 今すぐ村を解放するんだ！\nジャングルの中からの狙撃は全て\n私による: Orc! Release the village right now! All the jungle sniping was done by me! That should be enough, right?
m920069.ギァアア――ッ！？\nこ、こんな……はずでは……。: Giiiaaa—! This… isn't supposed to be like this…!
m920069.ギャ……ギャ……。\n仲間ヲ呼ブナンテ、ズルイ……。\nミンナ……ニゲロ、ニゲロ:
Gy…gy…
Calling for comrades is cheating…
Everyone… run, run…!
m920069.ギャギャッ！\n知ラナイ人間ガ来タゾ！？\nドウスル？ ドウスル？:
Gyahaha!
An unknown human has arrived!?
What do we do? What do we do?
m920069.クソっ！\n仕留め損なったか……！\nこのまま応戦するしかないか……。:
Damn it!
I missed the kill...! Looks like we have no choice but to keep fighting...
m920069.ダナンさんの言うことも一理ありますが……。\nそれでも、ここで逃げるわけにはいき:
Danan has a point, but…
We can't just run away now!
Prince, let's regroup and prepare for the main force!
m920069.バカ言ってんじゃねえ！ 今さらのこのこ\nやってきた帝国なんかに任せておけるかよ: Don't be ridiculous! We can't just leave it to the Empire that shows up now! Prince, let's head straight for the Orc stronghold!
m920069.ビフロンス……。\nやつがいる限り、\n不死者は何度でも蘇る……か。: Bifrons… As long as he's around, the undead keep resurrecting, huh.
m920069.ビフロンス様がいる限り、\nキサマら人間には勝ち目など無いのだ……。\nふははは: As long as Bifrons is here, you humans have no chance… Hehehe…!
m920069.ヤツらとも戦ってみたいところだが、\nまずは部隊長へ報告せねばいかんな……。\n: I'd love to fight them, but first I need to report to the squad leader… I'll leave this to them.
m920069.レーゼルさん……オーク本隊の襲来を\n報告しに帝国へと戻って頂けますか？\nもし: Rösel… could you return to the Empire to report the main Orc force's arrival? We might be able to get reinforcements.
m920069.レーゼルさんは先の戦いで腕を負傷しています。\n既に猟銃を握ることすらできない状: Rösel was wounded in the previous battle and can't even grip a rifle. I won't permit her to continue fighting.
m920069.人間か……ふむ、ちょうど良い。\nキサマらを殺して、不死者軍団の\n走狗として永:
Humans, huh… Fine, just right.
I'll kill you and bind you as eternal hounds of my undead army.
m920069.人間の集落などに興味はないが、\nこの地は戦いに適した開けた場所だ。\nこれで戦: I have no interest in human settlements, but this land is an open field perfect for battle. This will give us the advantage we need…
m920069.伝令！\nオーク軍団の接近を確認しました！\n皆さん、臨戦態勢をとってください！: Messenger! We've confirmed the Orc army approaching! Everyone, get ready for battle!
m920069.何をこそこそ話しているのですか……？\nレーゼルさんには早急な治療が必要なのです: What are you whispering about…? Rösel needs immediate treatment. Please come quickly to the medical tent.
m920069.凶悪な魔物を放ってはおけません。\n戦いの準備をお願いします！:
We can't let those vicious monsters run loose.
Prepare for battle!
m920069.力を貸してくれて……ありがとう。\nあのままでは、きっとやられていた……。: Thank you for lending me your strength… Thanks. If things had stayed that way, I'd surely have been killed…
m920069.助けてくれてありがとう。\n……じゃあ、私は他に行くところがあるから。: Thank you for rescuing me. …Well, I have somewhere else to go.
m920069.報告！\n前方に魔物の姿を確認！\n警戒してください！: Report! We've spotted a monster ahead! Stay on guard!
m920069.報告！\n竜の姿を確認！\n直ちに臨戦態勢をとってください！:
Report!
Dragon sighted!
Get into battle formation immediately!
m920069.好意は嬉しいが……すまない。\n私はこのまま独りでいくよ。\nそれじゃあ……。: I appreciate the sentiment, but… I'm sorry. I'll go my own way now. So…
m920069.実は、ずっと前から\n白の帝国はジャングルを守る為に\n多くの部隊を駐屯させてい: Actually, the White Empire has long stationed many troops in the jungle to protect it.
m920069.帝国とは戦ったこともありますが、\n共に協力して魔物を倒したこともあります。\n: We've fought the Empire before, but we've also teamed up to slay monsters together. Please, trust us.
m920069.弱ッテル今ナラ、キット倒セルハズ！\nミンナ、行クゾッ、ギャギャッ！: If they're weak now, we'll definitely take them down! Everyone, let's go, gyahaha!
m920069.強き者と相対するこの瞬間の何と甘美な事か。\nオークとは闘争の化身にして強さの権: How sweet this moment, facing a strong opponent. Orcs are the embodiment of battle and the very essence of strength! My body burns for greater glory!
m920069.悪いけど……それはできない。\n帝国と敵対している王子たちと\n馴れ合うことはで: I'm sorry, but… I can't do that. I can't cozy up with princes who are at odds with the Empire…
m920069.我らはこのまま帝国へと帰還することにする。\nなに、帰路くらいは我々でなんとかな:
We'll head back to the Empire as is.
We can manage the journey back ourselves.
Thanks for everything. Farewell.
m920069.撤退はしない……ですか。\n王子ならそう言うと思っていました。\n私も、最後まで:
We aren't retreating… right?
I thought you'd say that, Prince.
I'll stay by your side until the end.
m920069.敵の掃滅を確認しました。\nレーゼルさん、そして王子軍の皆さん、\nお疲れ様でし: The enemy has been cleared. Rösel, and everyone in the Prince's forces, good work.
m920069.既に機は熟している……。\nさあ王子、闘争に身を委ねるのだッ！\nいざ、尋常に…: The opportunity is already ripe… Come, Prince, surrender yourself to battle! Now, a fair… duel!
m920069.早まるなレーゼル！\nだめだ、聞こえていないようだ。\n王子、あたし達もすぐに加:
Don't be hasty, Rösel!
No, she's not hearing you.
Prince, we'll rush to help right away!
m920069.最初はどうなることかと思ったけど、\n何とかなってよかったね、王子！: At first I wasn't sure how it'd turn out, but we made it through. Good job, Prince!
m920069.最後の最後まで\n薄気味の悪いやつだったね……。: He was creepy right up to the very end…
m920069.本当に、感謝の念に堪えない……。\n我々もオークとの戦いに復帰するつもりで\nい:
Truly, I can't express my gratitude enough…
We were planning to rejoin the fight against the Orcs, but with these wounds we're just a liability.
m920069.気にすることはない。\nジャングルの平和を守る者同士、\n共に助け合うのは当然の:
Don't worry about it.
As fellow protectors of the jungle's peace, it's only natural we look out for each other.
m920069.王子、お見事です。\nあれだけの数の竜を倒してしまうとは……。\n強くなられまし:
Prince, splendid work.
To think you took down that many dragons… You've grown stronger.
m920069.王子、この度は本当にお疲れ様でした。\nそれでは、皆と共に帰還しましょう。:
Prince, thank you for everything you've done.
Now, let's return together with everyone.
m920069.王子、オークが撤退していきます。\nやりましたね。: Prince, the Orcs are retreating. We did it.
m920069.王子、オーク軍が一斉に攻めてきます！\nここでオークとの戦いに決着をつけましょう: Prince, the Orc army is launching a full assault! Let's settle this fight with the Orcs here. Prepare for battle!
m920069.王子、大量の竜が暴れているようです。: Prince, a huge number of dragons are rampaging.
m920069.王子、私達もユリアンさんに続きましょう！\n戦いの準備をお願いします！: Prince, we'll follow Julian's lead! Prepare for battle!
m920069.王子たちが来るまでに、\nジャングルで何があったか話すね。: Before the princes arrive, let me tell you what happened in the jungle.
m920069.生き残った者たちは次々と撤退したけど、\nレーゼルだけはジャングルに\n留まって: The survivors retreated one after another, but Rezel stayed in the jungle and kept fighting the Orcs.
m920069.申し訳ありません。\n王子軍との共闘は、我ら帝国兵にとっては\nあまり好ましいこ: My apologies. Joint action with the Prince's forces isn't exactly something the Imperial troops favor.
m920069.白の帝国！？\nルナールさん、これまで何があったのか\n話してくれますか？: The White Empire!? Lunarl-san, could you tell us what's happened so far?
m920069.真の強者には良き仲間が集う……か。\n王子、次に会う時が楽しみだな。更なる鍛錬を:
True strength draws worthy allies… huh.
Prince, I look forward to our next meeting. I'll train harder and swear to defeat you. Farewell!
m920069.確かこの方角に\nレーゼルは進んでいったはずだけど……。\n一向に見当たらないな: I'm sure Rezel went in that direction, but I can't find any sign of her.
m920069.礼はいい。\nそれよりもあんたが無事でよかった。\nこれからは協力してオークを倒: No need for thanks. I'm just glad you're safe. From now on, let's work together to defeat the Orcs.
m920069.私が滅びることはない……。\n……そう、魔神ビフロンス様がいる限り……、\n不死: I will never be destroyed… Yes, as long as the demon god Bifrons exists… the undead will rise again…
m920069.私は最後までオークと戦う……。\nそれが私の使命だから……。\n絶対に逃げない…: I'll keep fighting the Orcs till the very end… because that's my duty… I'll never run away…!
m920069.私をここから逃がそうという心遣いは不要だ。\n今さら援軍要請をしたところで間に合: You don't need to worry about getting me out of here. You all know that asking for reinforcements now won't make it in time.
m920069.絶好のタイミングだぜ、まったく。\nっしゃあ！ こっからが本番だぜ。\n王子、レ: Perfect timing, honestly. Alright! This is where the real fight starts. Prince, Rösel! Let's take those Orcs down!
m920069.聞くところによれば、\n白の帝国の皇帝にも比肩するほどの\n強者だという話だから: I've heard he's a powerhouse… comparable to the White Empire's emperor himself!
m920069.自ら地の利を捨てるとは間抜けな人間め。\nなぜ我らの前に現れた……。\nまあいい: Abandoning the terrain advantage yourself, you're a clueless human. Why did you appear before us… Well, fine, I'll take you down here.
m920069.良き報せがございます。\nついに、噂に名高い\n例の王子を発見しました！: Good news! At last, we've finally spotted the famed Prince of legend!
m920069.薄情？ 何てこというんだよ！\n帝国の兵達は部隊が壊滅する寸前まで\nジャングル: Cold-hearted? What are you talking about! The Imperial soldiers fought for the jungle right up until their unit was on the brink of annihilation!
m920069.融通の利かないやつだな。\nだがそれでこそ帝国兵だとも思ってしまう……。\nなか: What an inflexible guy. But that's exactly what makes him an Imperial soldier… She's pretty complicated, huh.
m920069.行け！ お前ら！\n人間どもを蹴散らせぇ！: Go! You all! Drive the humans away!
m920069.見たところ、王子軍の皆さんはかなり疲弊\nしているようですし……悪いことはいいま: From what I see, your side looks pretty exhausted… I won't sugarcoat it. Could you withdraw from this area?
m920069.貴方に心配されなくとも王子は負けません！\n私をはじめ、多くの仲間が絶対に王子を: Even without your worry, the Prince won't lose! With me and many comrades, we'll protect him no matter what!
m920069.逃げたいのなら止めないよ。\nいくら帝国軍が後ろにいるとはいえ、\n最前線は未だ: If you want to run, I won't stop you. Even with the Imperial troops behind us, we're still the only ones on the front line.
m920069.魔物の軍勢に対して抵抗を続ける人間……。\nその中で最も強い者と戦いたいと言う\: Humans who keep resisting the demon armies… The squad leader's wish to battle the strongest among them is finally coming true.
m920069.（――今のうちに笑っているがいい。\n……この一撃で仕留める……ッ！）: (—Better laugh while you can. …This strike… will kill him…!)

m920106.――そう、此度の黒幕は公爵だ。\n予とは派閥を異とする者達、\n支配派を率いるヴ: —Indeed, the mastermind this time is the Duke. Those opposed to us, the vampire lord leading the ruling faction...
m920106.――なるほど、やはり公爵の仕業か。: ――I see, so it was the Duke's doing after all.
m920106.――血液採取の永久機関、\nあまねく吸血種を救済する我が計画の成就、\nその道程: —The perpetual blood-draining engine, the fulfillment of my plan to rescue all vampiric kind—I've taken another step forward.
m920106.……いいえ……はい。\nそんな事はないと思ってはいるのですが、\n刻みつけられた: …No… yes. I don't really think that'll happen, but the fear that's been etched into me won't fade.
m920106.……えっ？\n私を……仲間に？: …Huh? You want me… as an ally?
m920106.……こうして剣を交えてみれば、\n悩んでいた時間が嘘みたいですね。: …Now that we've crossed swords, the time I spent worrying feels like a lie.

I suppose she won't wait forever……
But it doesn't seem like she intends to break her promise.
m920178.えぇ、おまかせを。\nまさか私たちの祈りが、\n障壁突破の鍵になるとは考えもしま:
Yes, leave it to us.
I never imagined that our prayers
would turn out to be the key to breaking through the barrier.
m920178.えぇ、進路を阻む者は、\nこの弓で撃ち落としてみせましょう。:
Yes, those who block our path
shall be shot down by this bow.
m920178.おぉ、おぉ！\n我らが主が、天使様を遣わしてくださったぞ！\n天使様に続け！ 神:
Oh, oh!
Our Lord has sent the angels to aid us!
Follow the angels! Holy Knights!!
m920178.お前たちは撤退しろ。\n転移の時間くらいは、私の命を賭せば稼げるだろう。:
You all retreat.
I can buy enough time for the teleportation by staking my life.
m920178.かつてのオリュンポスは、\n創造神による、世界を生み出すための実験場よ。\nでも:
The ancient Olympus was
the Creator's testing ground for creating the world.
But what has become of it now……
m920178.かつての創造神の庭、といったところかしら。\n今では、亜神ディアスの領土となって:
It must have been the garden of the Creator god once upon a time.
Now, it has become the territory of the sub-god Zeus.
m920178.くっ……なぜ止まらない……。\nこちらの方が数は上なのだぞ……！:
Grr…… why won't they stop……
We have the numerical advantage……!
m920178.くっ……なんという抵抗だ……。\n王国軍め、決死の覚悟ということか……！:
Grrr… what kind of resistance is this…
The Kingdom's army… are they prepared to die?
m920178.くっ……全軍撤退だ！\n隊長殿の命を無駄にするな！:
Grr……full retreat!
Don't waste the Captain's life!
m920178.けれど、そうではなかった。\n亜神ディアス、あなたが模倣した魔術は、\n私たちの:
But that wasn't the case.
Lesser God Dias, the magic you imitated
was within our reach.
m920178.けれど、そのおかげで補給拠点を築くこともできます。\n今はオリュンポス攻略に向け:
However, that gives us the chance to establish supply lines.
For now, let's proceed with constructing our positions in the Celestial Realm
in preparation for the assault on Olympus.
m920178.このまま押し通る！\n皆さん、騎兵の後に続いてください！:
We're pushing through!
Everyone, follow the cavalry!
m920178.この地へ召喚するのではなく、\nこの地から、彼方の地へと召喚していたのだと、\n:
We realized that instead of summoning to this land,
we were summoning from this land to that other one.
Once we saw that, all that was left was to analyze the formula.
m920178.この地までたどり着けるというのなら、\n実力をもって果たしてみせるがいい。:
If you believe you can reach this place,
then prove it with your strength.
m920178.この場所に、女神アイギスを信奉する\n王国軍の精鋭部隊が揃っているのだな。:
It seems the elite forces of the Kingdom,
who worship the Goddess Aegis, have gathered here.
m920178.この後の作戦、「オリュンポスの開門」のためには、\nもっとガッツリ戦力を削りたい:
For the next phase of the operation, “Opening the Gates of Olympus,”
we really need to wear down their strength even more.
m920178.この橋を超えれば、障壁の内側、\nつまりオリュンポスの麓へ直接たどりつく。:
Once we cross this bridge, we will be inside the barrier,
heading directly for the foothills of Olympus.
m920178.この障壁は、女神アイギスによる封印の権能。\n数多くの魔物を封じ、\n千年戦争を:
This barrier is the sealing Authority of the Goddess Aigis.
It mimics the barrier that sealed countless monsters
and brought an end to the Millennium War.
m920178.こら、アリシア。\n私を照れ隠しに使わないように。:
Hey, Alicia.
Stop using me as a shield for your shyness.
m920178.こんなところで足止めされてる時間はない。\n王子、神聖騎士団を蹴散らそう。\n迅:
We can't afford to be held up here.
Prince, let's sweep the Holy Knights off their feet.
I'm counting on your swift command!
m920178.さぁ、かかってくるがいい、乾いた地の民よ。: Now then, come at me, you people of the dry land.
m920178.さぁ、心の準備はいいかな？\nここからは時間との戦い。\n王子の指揮と実力に、全:
Are you ready? This is a race against time.
We are betting everything on the Prince's command and skill!
m920178.さぁ、次は天使と神聖騎士団、\n両方を相手取った戦いだ。\n戦術家としての、腕の:
Now, the next battle will be against both the angels and the Holy Knights.
It's time to show off your skills as a tactician.
m920178.さぁ、行け。\n今日は勝ちを譲ろう。:
Now, go.
I shall grant you victory today.
m920178.さすがはオリュンポスの麓、か。\n王子、油断するなよ。天界の守護兵が混じっている:
I suppose it's to be expected at the foot of Olympus.
Prince, stay alert. The Celestial Guard is mixed in with them!
m920178.されど、この障壁は絶対なるもの。\nケラウノス様のため、神聖なるオリュンポスを、:
Nevertheless, this barrier is absolute.
For Lord Keraunos, for the sacred Olympus,
I will――grrr……for the sake of Lord Keraunos……
m920178.し、神官戦士団長殿まで……！？\nすごい、王国軍の最精鋭ばかり……！:
To be addressed as Commander of the Divine Warrior Corps……!?
Amazing. The Royal Army's absolute elite are all here……!
m920178.すみません、行軍の最中にぐだぐだと悩んでしまって。\n……私も、自分の道を選び続:
I'm sorry for dawdling and overthinking in the middle of a march.
……I'll keep choosing my own path.
m920178.せめて、苦しまずに済むよう、\nしばしの眠りにつかせてあげましょう。:
At the very least, let us let him fall into a temporary slumber,
so he need not suffer.
m920178.そう、ですね……。\n王子、皆さん、お疲れ様でした！:
Yes, that's right……
Prince, everyone, well done!
m920178.そう、ですよね……。\nだってこの方の瞳は、まるで騎士に憧れる子供のようで。:
Yes, that's right…….
Because her eyes look like those of a child who idolizes knights.
m920178.そこで、今回の「オリュンポス開門作戦」だ。\n王子率いる最精鋭で、\nオリュンポ:
That is why we have the "Olympus Gate Opening Operation."
A select force led by the Prince will destroy the barrier of Olympus from the inside!
m920178.そこに計算や打算はない。\n奴にとって、自身以外のあらゆるものは等しく価値を持た:
There is no calculation or scheming in it.
To him, everything outside of himself holds no value.
All that exists is the way a god ought to conduct himself.
m920178.そして転送魔術とは、\nすなわち「召喚」の権能を劣化、模倣したもの。:
And teleportation magic is
a degraded, imitated form of the “Summoning” Authority.
m920178.そのとおりです兵士長！\n日々の訓練の成果、今こそ発揮する時！:
That's right, Captain!
It's time to put our daily training to the test!
m920178.その作戦を組み上げた一員が、\nいまさら恥ずかしがってどうするの。:
You were part of the team that came up with that plan.
Why are you acting shy about it now?
m920178.その剣に、誇りあるならばかかってくるがいい！\n盲信こそ悪であると知りなさい！:
If you have pride in your swords, then come at me!
Learn that blind faith is the true evil!
m920178.それから先を決めるのは彼女自身ですからね。\n願わくば、生きることを望んでくれる:
And it is for her alone to decide what comes next.
I hope she will choose to live.
m920178.それが、人類にとって\n望まぬ世界であったとしても、ですか。: Even if that is a world humanity does not desire?
m920178.それこそいらぬ心配だ、と行動で示してやろう。\n何しろ、王国軍は王子が育て上げた:
Let's show him that concern is unnecessary.
After all, the Kingdom's army was built by the Prince.
m920178.それに、強くなれとは……。\nこちらが強くなったら、\n亜神ディアスにとって不利:
And "become stronger"……
If we grow stronger,
wouldn't that be a disadvantage for Lesser God Dias?
m920178.それに我らが主であれば、\n理不尽は、鉄槌をもって打ち砕けと説いたはず。:
Besides, our Lord
taught us to shatter injustice with the hammer of iron.
m920178.それは、諦観というものですよ。\n人の持ちうる強さから、最も遠い感情です。:
That is resignation.
It is the emotion furthest from the strength a person can possess.
m920178.それゆえに！\n王子、最初から全力で指揮を頼むよ！:
Therefore!
Prince, I'm counting on you to command at full power from the start!
m920178.そろそろ、王国軍本隊が障壁の前に到着する頃です。\n合流まで何事も無ければよいの:
The main body of the Royal Army should be reaching the barrier any moment now.
I hope nothing goes wrong until we link up……
m920178.だからこそ、神聖騎士団も\nかなりの戦力を割いているはずだ。\nそしてそれは、こ:
That's precisely why the Holy Knights
must have committed a significant portion of their forces.
And that means, for us as well—
m920178.だが、貴様らとて庇護すべき愚かなる創造神の被造物。\nこの手で殺すのは、余の流儀:
But you, too, are mere creations of the foolish Creator
whom I am bound to protect.
Killing you with my own hands would go against my nature.
m920178.でも、今度は大丈夫。\n必要なピースは、揃っているから。:
But this time, it'll be fine.
We have all the pieces we need.
m920178.どう、かな……。\n敵の数は、確実に減ってる。\n最初の激突に、最大の戦力をぶつ:
Let's see……
The enemy numbers are definitely thinning out.
I'd like to believe they threw their strongest forces at us in that initial clash.
m920178.どうか、迷えるあの娘を救い出してやってくれ。\nこれは私の個人的な――\n君の友:
Please, save that lost girl.
This is my personal—
A small wish from your friend.
m920178.なぜ理解しない、理解しようともしない。\n何の苦難も悲しみもない、\n停滞と安寧:
Why do you fail to understand? Why do you refuse even to try?
I am offering you a world free of all suffering and sorrow,
a world of stasis and peace.
m920178.なに心配してやがる。\n向こうで待ってるのは、俺たちの王子だぜ？:
What's with the worry?
The one waiting for us on the other side is our Prince.
m920178.なるほど、そういう意見もあることでしょう。: I see. That is a valid perspective, I suppose.
m920178.はぁ、はぁ……。\n待たせたね、王子っ！！:
Haa, haa……
Sorry for keeping you waiting, Prince!!
m920178.はいっ！ 女神アイギス様、\nその「権能」の一端をお貸しください！！:
Yes! Goddess Aigis,
please lend us a fragment of your “Authority”!!
m920178.はっ、隊長殿。しかし我らの信仰心は、\n連中の覚悟に負けるはずもありませぬ！\n:
Aye, Captain. But our faith
will never be defeated by their resolve!
Even if we are all destroyed, let us show them the radiance of our Lord!
m920178.はっ！ 我らに祈りを！ 我らが主に栄光を！: Aye! Prayer with us! Glory to our Lord!
m920178.ふっふっふ、何しろビフロストは、\nディアスめの障壁を無視して、\n直接オリュン:
Heh heh heh, after all, Bifrost is a bridge that
ignores Dias's barrier and connects directly to Olympus, you know.
m920178.ふふ、そんな目で見られても困るな。\n私はね、君にかつての主と同じものを見出した:
Fufu, don't look at me like that.
I see the same thing in you that I saw in your former master.
The unyielding power to shatter injustice and keep moving forward.
m920178.ふふ、恋する乙女じゃないのですから。\nほら、瞳を輝かせていないで、早くこちらへ:
Fufu. I'm not some lovestruck maiden.
Come on, stop staring with those sparkling eyes and get over here.
This is about to become the front line!
m920178.ふん……貴様は人類如きに期待し過ぎだ。\n連中に、未来を見通す慧眼などあるものか:
Hmph… You place too much hope in creatures like humans.
Do they truly possess the wisdom to foresee the future?
m920178.ふん、そんなものは蹴散らせば済む話だ。\n敵の布陣は王子たちの方が分厚い。\n俺:
Pfft, we'll just kick them aside.
The Prince's side has the thicker deployment.
We don't have time to be complaining.
m920178.へへっ、間違いない！\nてめぇら、このまま突っ切るぞ！！:
Heh, no doubt about it!
Listen up, you guys! We're pushing straight through!!
m920178.まずはこの地に陣を築き、\n今後の方策を練ることにしましょう！:
First, let us establish a base here
and plan our next moves!
m920178.まだ、後戻りできるのではないかね。\nこれが間違った道だと、もう気付いているのだ:
It is not too late to turn back, is it?
You must realize by now that this is the wrong path.
m920178.まったく、レーヴまで！\nいいか、我々頭脳派は全力で胸を張っておけ！:
Honestly, even Reve!
Listen, we intellectuals should hold our heads high with confidence!
m920178.むっ、空からとは卑怯な……。: Hmph, attacking from the air is cowardly…….
m920178.もう、気付いているのでしょう？\n信仰の矛盾に、神の不在に、\nその事実に自らた:
You've realized it, haven't you?
The contradictions in your faith, the absence of the divine—
You reached that truth on your own.
m920178.もう二度とこの地を踏めぬよう、\nそうだな、空の果て、\nあるいは遥かな地の底に:
So that you may never tread this ground again,
how about the edge of the sky,
or perhaps the depths of a distant land?
m920178.もしこれが、女神アイギス様の「召喚」そのものなら、\n私たちでは手が届くこともな:
If this had been the Goddess Aigis's true “Summoning,”
it would have been a miraculous formula so complexly intertwined
that it would have been beyond our reach.
m920178.やはり来たか。\n天界への架け橋、ビフロストの起動直前に\n奴らが侵攻してくるの:
So they've finally come.
It was only a matter of time before they attacked
right before we could activate Bifrost, the bridge to the Celestial Realm.
m920178.ゆくぞ、裏切り者たちよ。\n我が名はデシレア！ 光剣の騎士なり！:
Come, you traitors.
My name is Desilea! I am the Knight of the Light Sword!
m920178.よぉ、気合入ってんじゃねぇかユリアン。\nだがまだ先は長いぜ？ 大丈夫か？:
Yo, you're really fired up, Julian.
But we've got a long way to go, don't we? You okay?
m920178.よし、このままオリュンポスの障壁まで突っ切るぞ！\nディアスより早く、迅速に、だ:
Good. Let's push straight through to the barrier of Olympus!
Faster and more swiftly than Dias!
m920178.よし、前回の分析は正しかった。\nこの障壁は巨大過ぎるがゆえに、\n全域に戦力を:
Good, my previous analysis was correct.
This barrier is so vast that they have no choice
but to spread their forces thin across the entire area.
m920178.よろしい。\nでは元気も出たところで、治療を受けてくださいね。\nあちらでエクス:
Very well.
Now that you're feeling better, let's get you treated.
Ex is waving you over that way.
m920178.ん、そういうことだ。\n天界へ乗り込むにあたって、\n神聖騎士団の戦力は可能な限:
Mm, exactly.
Before we make our move on the Celestial Realm,
we want to weaken the Holy Knights' forces as much as possible.
m920178.アナベラちゃん、不安になる語尾をつけないの！\n叡智の園の代表なんだから！:
Anabella, stop using that uncertain tone!
You're the representative of the Garden of Wisdom!
m920178.アラエルさま……。\nうぅぅ、見てられないよ、あんな姿……。:
Master Arael…….
Ugh, I can't bear to look at you like this……
m920178.アラエルさま！\nよかった、無事だったんだね！:
Master Arael!
Oh, thank goodness, you're safe!
m920178.オリュンポスの障壁、そのこちら側でこの抵抗。\n王子たちは無事でしょうか……。:
We're holding the line on this side of the Olympus Barrier.
I hope the Princes are safe……
m920178.オリュンポスを超えたその先で、\n余は貴様を待ち続けようぞ。:
Beyond Olympus,
I shall wait for you.
m920178.ギガエル様、クラールフ様の天使たるあなたが、\nなぜ亜神ディアスに加担するのです:
Gigael, you are an angel of Claufrue.
Why do you side with Lesser God Dias?
m920178.デシレア、なぜ顔を伏せているのですか。\n勇猛果敢なるあなたらしくもない。:
Desilea, why are you lowering your head?
This is hardly like the brave and daring you.
m920178.デシレア隊長、総員準備は整っております。\n今こそ、我らが雷神様の鉄槌を、\n邪:
Captain Desilea, all units are ready.
Now is the moment to bring the Thunder God's hammer
down upon the heretics!
m920178.デシレア！ 生きて――\nいや、負けた者に興味はない。どこへなりと行くがいい。:
Desilea! You're alive――
No. I have no interest in the defeated. Go where you will.
m920178.ドゥマルデ審問官……いや、元審問官か。\n裏切り者に、語る言葉はない。:
Inquisitor Domalde……no, former Inquisitor.
I have no words for a traitor.
m920178.万にひとつのその時が訪れたならば、\n人類が、我が雷霆の敵であると認めてやろう。:
Should that one-in-a-million moment ever come,
I will acknowledge that humanity is an enemy worthy of my thunder.
m920178.予想はしていたけど、\n想定していた展開の中では悪い方かな。\n王子、悪いがこの:
I expected it, but
this is the worse of the scenarios I anticipated.
Prince, I'm sorry, but this is going to be a series of continuous battles!
m920178.亜神、ディアス……？\n何を言っているのです、私は……ケラウノス様の、\n真なる:
The Lesser God, Dias……?
What are you saying? I am……for the sake of Lord Keraunos's
true, will……
m920178.亜神ディアス、あなたが本来持っていた権能は、\n創造神によって剥奪され、\nそれ:
Lesser God Dias, the Authority you originally possessed
was stripped from you by the Creator,
and those fragments gave birth to the Three Goddesses.
m920178.亜神ディアス、本当に\nオリュンポスで待っているつもりなのでしょうか……。:
Is the Lesser God Dias really
planning to wait at Olympus……?
m920178.人類が不完全な存在であることは、\n貴様らでも理解の及ぶところだろう。:
That humanity is an imperfect existence
is something even you should be able to comprehend.
m920178.人類よ、オリュンポスへ挑むことを許そう。\n原初の実験場、創造神の庭、\n我が居:
Humans, I permit you to challenge Olympus.
Come to my holy fortress,
the primordial testing ground, the Creator's garden.
m920178.今は、少しだけ眠るといい。\n次に目覚める時は、天界についた後だ。:
You should rest for a little while now.
When you wake up next, we will have already reached the heavens.
m920178.任せてください！\nエクスさんも準備は良いですか？:
Leave it to us!
Are you ready, Exus?
m920178.伝承の分析、神話の再解釈、\n魔術式の組み立ても万全――な、はずです！:
The analysis of the legends, the reinterpretation of the myths,
the assembly of the magic formulas are all in order――I think!
m920178.何しろ介入されると、例の転移魔術が飛んでくるからね。\n術式の解析はしてあるし、:
If we get involved, that teleportation magic of theirs is bound to fly our way.
We've analyzed the spell and have countermeasures,
but it's best not to get hit at all!
m920178.余がすべての力を取り戻した暁には、\n愚かなる創造神の失敗、\nその全てを打ち消:
Once I have reclaimed all of my power,
I will erase every failure
of that foolish Creator.
m920178.余が不機嫌、だと？\nそうだな、確かにそうかもしれぬ。:
Is it so?
Yes, I suppose it is.
m920178.余は創造神の被造物たる人類を愛しているのだ。\nゆえに、愚かな行いには、心を痛め:
I love humanity, the creations of the God of Creation.
Therefore, it is only natural that I am pained by their foolish actions.
m920178.作戦中に邪魔されちゃ困るからね。\n――よし、目論見どおり、\n神聖騎士団が戦線:
It would be a problem if they interfered during the operation.
—Good, just as planned,
the Holy Knights are returning to the front lines.
m920178.兵への演説も頼むぜ？\n王国の全軍を投入した作戦だったんだ。\nみんな、王子の言:
And don't forget to give a speech to the troops?
We're throwing the entire kingdom's army into this operation.
Everyone is eagerly waiting to hear what you have to say.
m920178.創造神なき今、愚かなる人類を導くのは余の役目。\nなれば矮小なる羽虫たちの未来の:
Now that the God of Creation is gone, it is my duty to guide foolish humanity.
If so, is it not my mission to bring them a world of stagnation and peace,
for the sake of these petty gnats' future?
m920178.同時に、既に確保しているルートから\n王国軍の本隊を進軍、合流する手筈です。:
At the same time, the main force of the Royal Army will advance through the routes we have already secured
to join up with them.
m920178.問うべきはそこではないかもしれませんよ。\nむしろ――ギガエル、あなたはなぜ、\:
That may not be the right question to ask.
Rather――Gigael, why are you not under Lesser God Dias's mental domination?
m920178.問題はビフロストで移動できる人数に制限があること。\n小部隊を何度も転移させてい:
The problem is the limit on how many people can cross Bifrost.
If we keep teleporting small squads over,
they will be picked off one by one on the other side.
m920178.喚くな、余が全力をもって相対してやろうというのだ。\n相応しい時、相応しい舞台が:
Do not call it that. I intend to face you with my full power.
A worthy time and a worthy stage are required, are they not?
m920178.大天使長、まさか命を賭してまで\nこの障壁を守るつもりですか？:
Archangel, are you truly willing to stake your life
to defend this barrier?
m920178.大天使長と、天槍騎兵だけ……？\nやけに戦力が薄いですね。:
Just the Archangel and the Celestial Lancers……?
Their forces are surprisingly thin.
m920178.天界で会おうって、王子に言われたんだ。\n一瞬だって遅れてたまるかよ！\nなぁ皆:
The Prince told me to meet him in the heavens.
I can't afford to be late, not even for a second!
Come on, everyone! Let's show them the true strength of the Royal Army!
m920178.天界の守護兵は強力な戦士だ。\n可能なら、動き出す前に決着を付けたいところだが―:
The Celestial Guard are powerful warriors.
Ideally, we'd want to end this before they even move――
But I'll leave that judgment to you, Prince.
m920178.奇策もまた策のうち。\n前回はディアスに好き放題されたからね、\n同じ失敗をしな:
A bold strategy is still a strategy.
Since Dias got away with whatever he wanted last time,
we have to do at least this much to avoid repeating the same mistake.
m920178.女神アイギスが助力したとでも――\n否、これは、そうか、余の権能を解読したのかッ:
You claim the Goddess Aigis assisted you――
No, this is… I see, you decoded my Authority!!
m920178.女神アイギス様への祈りが術式を解き、\nその細く鋭い廻廊へ、私たちが魔力を叩き込:
Prayers to the Goddess Aigis unravel the formula,
and we pour our mana into its fine, sharp corridors.
That alone is enough to easily shatter this delicate formula.
m920178.奴は己に挑む者を尊重する。\n神とは座して待ち、\n不遜なる挑戦者を迎え撃つもの:
He respects those who dare to challenge him.
He believes that a god should sit in judgment,
awaiting and repelling the arrogant challengers who come.
m920178.奴らはまとわりつく羽虫に過ぎぬ。\n輝きに寄り集まり、そして輝きに焼かれ死んでい:
They are nothing but gnats clinging to me.
Dust that gathers around the light, only to be burned and die by it.
m920178.安寧の内に生き、死ぬことこそ人類の幸福。\n英雄などという幻想は、いらぬ夢を見せ:
To live and die in peace is the true happiness of humanity.
"Heroes" are nothing but a poison that shows us unnecessary dreams.
m920178.己の目的を達成する上で、\n王子こそが最大の敵となると認識したんじゃないかしら。:
Perhaps she has realized that you, Prince,
are the greatest obstacle to achieving her goal.
m920178.我が使命を阻むのであれば、\n我が主の盟友とて容赦はしない。:
If you stand in the way of my mission,
I will show no mercy, not even to my Lord's allies.
m920178.我が敬愛する創造主は、未だ健在であるがゆえに。\n我が権能は、過去も未来も変わる:
It is because my beloved Creator is still alive.
My authority remains unchanged, past and future alike,
wielded for the denizens of the sea and for my Lord.
m920178.我らが主が、天使様を遣わしてくださったぞ！\n天使様に続け！ 神聖騎士団よ！！:
Our Lord has sent the angels to aid us!
Follow the angels! Holy Knights!!
m920178.我らが過つことはない。\n雷神の加護が、我らを導いているのだから。:
We do not err.
The blessing of the Thunder God guides us.
m920178.戦場で死ぬのだ、悪い気分ではない。\nさぁ行け、我が同胞たちよ。:
Dying on the battlefield……it's not a bad way to go.
Now go, my comrades.
m920178.数少ない「神の楔」まで用いた世界樹の災厄、\nそれを乗り越えられたことが原因か…:
Is it because you managed to overcome the calamity of the World Tree,
even after deploying one of the few "God's Wedges"?
m920178.敵が飛んでるって？\nそれなら、弓兵隊におまかせあれ！:
The enemies are flying?
Then leave it to the archers!
m920178.本来は天界の秩序を守護する者だというのに……。\n完全にディアスの手駒になってい:
They were originally supposed to be the guardians of Celestial order……
It seems they've become nothing more than Dias's pawns.
m920178.決して気を抜かないように！\n彼らの死をも怖れぬ戦い方、\n騎士修道会の頃とは別:
Don't let your guard down!
Their way of fighting, unafraid of death,
is something entirely different from the Knight Monks!
m920178.決戦には間に合いましたか？: Did we make it in time for the decisive battle?
m920178.王子、ここからが亜神ディアスとの戦いの本番です。\nまずは十分な休息を、それから:
Prince, this is where the real war against the Lesser God Dias begins.
First, get some proper rest, and then――
m920178.王子、君ならば、\n彼女を目覚めさせることができるかね？:
Prince, do you think
you can awaken her?
m920178.王子、周囲に天使が集結しています。\nどうやら、話を聞いてくれる様子ではなさそう:
Prince, angels are gathering around us.
It doesn't look like they'll be willing to listen to reason.
m920178.王子、天使の軍団が来るぞ！\n迎撃の指揮を任せた！:
Prince, the angelic host is coming!
I'm leaving the counterattack to you!
m920178.王子、貴様は永遠に、\n人類を庇護し続けるだけの覚悟があるのか……？:
Prince, do you truly have the resolve
to shield humanity forever……?
m920178.王子さま！ 神聖騎士団の第一陣、撃破です！\nこのまま防衛を続けますよー！:
Prince! The Holy Knights' first wave is destroyed!
We'll keep up the defense as it is!
m920178.王子よ、さらなる力を身につけよ。\n小手先の力ではない、真なる英雄としての力を。:
Prince, acquire greater power.
Not mere surface strength, but the power of a true hero.
m920178.王子よ、貴様こそ我が雷霆の敵であると、\nここに認めようではないか。:
Prince, I hereby acknowledge that
you are the enemy of my thunderbolt.
m920178.王子殿下！ 例の天使を支配する魔力の波動が！\n彼はおそらく、亜神ディアスに……:
Your Highness! The magical waves that control that angel!
He is likely being……by the Lesser God Dias!
m920178.疑念を、信仰を、諦観を、\nあらゆるものを捨てて初めて、\nようやく本音を口にで:
Only after casting aside doubt, faith, and resignation,
discarding everything,
was she finally able to speak her true feelings.
m920178.知ったことか。\n騎士の矜持とて、無力となればすり減るものだ。:
I don't care.
Even a knight's pride wears away when they are powerless.
m920178.神が真に人を愛しているのなら、\n何も考えず、抗うこともなく、\n甘んじて死にゆ:
If God truly loved humanity,
He would not demand that we die without thought or resistance.
m920178.神の術を読み解き、神域を犯す不敬、\nその偉業に免じて赦すとしよう。:
For the audacity of deciphering a god's workings
and trespassing into a divine realm,
I shall grant you my pardon.
m920178.神を、団長を裏切り、部下を裏切り、\n騎士にあるまじき行いをしたというのに。:
I betrayed the gods, the Commander, and my subordinates.
A knight should never act so.
m920178.神聖騎士団が兵を引いています。\n今なら精鋭部隊を、ビフロストで送り込むことが―:
The Holy Knights are withdrawing their troops.
Now is the chance to send our elite unit through Bifrost――
m920178.私たちの誰ひとりとして、そんなことは思っていませんよ。\n己の信念に従ったのでし:
Not one of us thinks that way.
You simply followed your convictions, didn't you?
The question is which path is the right one for a knight to choose.
m920178.空からわらわらと……。\nアナベラ殿、これも予想の範囲内か？:
Coming down from the sky in swarms……
Lady Anabella, is this within your expectations?
m920178.精神支配が進行して……。\nアラエル、私の声は届きませんか……？:
The mental domination is progressing……
Arael, can you hear me……?
m920178.精神支配装置がディアスの手にある以上、\nいま、彼にしてあげられることはありませ:
As long as the mental domination device is in Dias's hands,
there is nothing we can do for him right now.
m920178.考えてみれば、とても単純なことだったんです。\nあなたの振るう権能の多くは、\n:
In retrospect, it was quite simple.
Much of the Authority you wielded
was of the same lineage as that of the Three Goddesses.
m920178.英雄たる者よ、その同胞たちよ、\nここでその芽、刈らせてもらうぞ。:
You who call yourselves heroes, and your compatriots,
I will cut down that seed right here.
m920178.被造物に自由意思などあるものか。\n意志だ正義だ理想だと喚くあの妄言は、\nすべ:
Do creations possess free will?
The ravings of "will," "justice," and "ideals" are
nothing but a facade of falsehood.
m920178.諦めたって言うな、\n後悔してるって言うな、選んだって言え。\nその誇りがあれば:
Don't say you gave up,
and don't say you regret it. Say you chose this.
With that pride, a knight can fight for a thousand years.
m920178.諦めたのではなく、選んだ……？: I didn't give up, I chose……?
m920178.負傷者はいるか！\n誰ひとり置いていったりしねぇからな、\n遠慮なく申告しやがれ:
Any injuries?
Don't you dare leave anyone behind.
Report your condition, no excuses!
m920178.近衛騎士団長か、天馬騎士団長、\n噂に聞く魔竜騎士や、万刃の担い手とも……戦って:
The Commander of the Royal Guard, the Commander of the Pegasus Knights,
the Dragon Knight I've heard rumors of, or the Bearer of Ten Thousand Blades……fighting one of them……
m920178.近衛騎士団長殿……。\nいえ、私はそんな、誇れるような決断をしていません。:
Commander of the Royal Guard……
No, I didn't make a decision I can be proud of.
m920178.迷いなどあるものか。\n人の未来を担う者に、迷う暇などありはしない。:
There is no such thing as doubt.
Those who bear the future of humanity have no time to hesitate.
m920178.連戦、転戦は王国軍の得意分野でしょう？\n遊撃隊を神聖騎士団への牽制にあてました:
Continuous battles and rapid maneuvers are the Kingdom's army's specialty, aren't they?
We've deployed the guerrilla unit to keep the Holy Knights in check.
Let's take on the angels head-on.
m920178.過去より学ばぬ愚か者どもよ、\n再び彼方の地へ送ってやろう。:
You fools who have learned nothing from the past,
I shall send you back to that other land once more.
m920178.隊長殿、何かおっしゃいましたか？\nすみません、上手く聞き取れず……！:
Captain, did you say something?
I'm sorry, I couldn't quite hear you……!
m920178.障壁まであと少し。\n道を拓くところまでは任せて。\n――その後は、大丈夫そう？:
Just a little further to the barrier.
Leave clearing the path to us.
――After that, do you think you'll be okay?
m920178.頼もしい限りだぜ！\nよしお前ら、戦闘準備だ！！:
That's reassuring!
Alright, everyone, get ready for battle!!
m920178.飼い犬に噛まれることを怖れ、\nその首をはねる飼い主こそ愚かなものだ。:
A master who fears being bitten by his dog
and cuts its throat is the true fool.
m920178.騎士とは意地っ張りなものですから。\n騎士を慰めるのは、騎士の役割というものでし:
Knights are such stubborn creatures.
It is the role of a knight to comfort another knight.
m920178.騎士は規範、過つことなく、道を踏み外すこともない。\nそうあり続けようとする限り:
A knight is a standard, never erring, never straying from the path.
As long as you strive to remain so,
you are a knight――or so the Commander says.
m920178.騎士団を裏切り、そちらに行けば、\n私も救われるとでもいうのか……？:
Are you saying that if I betray the Order and join your side,
I, too, will be saved……?
m920178.（……あれのどこが、決死の覚悟だというのだ。\nただ、我らの力が及んでいないわけ:
(……Where is the resolve to die in that?
They're simply beyond the reach of our power, aren't they?)
m920178.（……なぜ、誰もそこに疑念を抱かない。\nドゥマルデ審問官は、それに気付きながら:
(……Why does no one question this?
Inquisitor Dumarde saw through it, yet why
did he abandon the rest of the knights?)
m920178.（……信仰が、判断力を鈍らせている。\nかつての勇猛な戦士たちが、その力を信仰に:
(……Faith is dulling their judgment.
Those once-fierce warriors are having their strength eroded by their devotion.)
m920178.（……我らが主、か。\nふざけるなよ、命を捨てろだなどと、\n我が主が命じるはず:
(……Our Lord, is it.
Don't make me laugh. There's no way our true Lord
would command us to throw away our lives!)
m920178.（……私は、どうすればいいのだ。\n狂信に堕ちた同胞に、死ねと命じるしかないのか:
(……What am I supposed to do?
Must I order my own people, lost to fanaticism, to die?)
m920178.（もはや、王国軍は次の戦いを見据えている。\n信仰という名の盲目に毒された騎士団:
(The Kingdom's army is already looking ahead to the next battle.
The Knights, blinded by their so-called faith,
cannot even see the future war coming.)
m920178.（もはや、疑う余地もない。\n雷の鉄槌、我らの信ずる雷神様は、\n既にその名を騙:
(There is no longer any room for doubt.
The hammer of thunder, the Thunder God we truly believe in,
must have already been slain by that false god who wears his name.)

m920202.……いや、これは陽動だろう。\n相手の目的はおそらく、戦力の分断だ。:
……No, this is a diversion.
Their objective is likely to split our forces.
m920202.……いや、仕事は仕事だ。行くぞお前たち！: ……No, work is work. Let's go, you all!
m920202.……おそらくこの場にいる者たちの中に、\n誰かを失ったことがない者はいないだろう:
...I imagine that among those present,
there is no one who has not lost someone.
m920202.……きっと、諸君らも同じはずだ。\n道半ばに倒れた者たちの意志を受け継ぎ、\n我:
...I am sure you feel the same way.
We must carry on the will of those who fell along the way,
and continue to move forward.
m920202.……そう、姐さんはその子を庇うのね。\nいいわ、私も遊びに来たわけではないもの。: ……I see. You still protect her, don't you, Sis? Fine. I didn't come here to play.
m920202.……ふむ、厄介な相手が消えてくれた。\nさすがに複数の亜神相手は堪えるからな。:
……Hmph, troublesome opponents have vanished.
Fighting multiple demigods at once is quite a strain, after all.
m920202.……もう少し笑ったらどう？\n殺気がまるで隠せてないわよ。:
……Could you try smiling a bit?
You're not hiding your killing intent at all.
m920202.……スッキリしたわ、あいつ嫌いなのよね。: ……That feels refreshing. I really dislike him.
m920202.……スラムのコソ泥風情がよく吠えるわね。\nよくもまあ信用なんて言葉を口にできた: ……How dare a gutter thief from the slums bark at me. And to even use the word "trust"……. Do you think a change of heart wipes your past clean?
m920202.……テメェら全員木っ端微塵にしてやる。: ……I'll turn every last one of you to splinters.
m920202.……トラム姉様のようにはいきませんね。: ……I don't think I can measure up to Sister Tram.
m920202.……初対面だけど私、貴女のこと嫌いよ。: ...We just met, but I hate you.
m920202.……別に、最初から疑ってなどいない。\nお前が嘘をつかないことはよく知っている。:
...I never doubted you in the first place.
I know you don't lie.
m920202.……姉を庇ったか。あの傷では助かるまい。: ……She shielded you. With that wound, she won't survive.
m920202.……姐さん、可能な限り時間を稼いで。\n亜神たちが戻ってくるまで耐えるのよ。:
……Sister, buy us as much time as you can.
We need to hold out until the demigods return.
m920202.……最後まで責任が持てないなら、\n最初から拾わなければ良かったのに。:
……If you couldn't take responsibility to the end,
you shouldn't have picked me up in the first place.
m920202.……正義に目覚めた、とでも言っておきましょうか。: ……Let's just say I've awakened to the light of justice.
m920202.……知り合いなんてもんじゃねぇ。\nこいつは、この女は闇の組織の金庫番だ。\n金: She's a monster who will do anything for money.
m920202.……簡単に決めて良いのかしら？\n闇の組織の金庫番の悪評は知っているでしょ、\n:
...Is it really that simple to decide?

You know the bad reputation the Dark Organization's vault keeper has, don't you?

Being lenient with me will only earn me the resentment of the merchants.
m920202.……貴女たちは私をそういう扱いにしたいの？: ……Is that how you wish to treat me?
m920202.……追撃は任せて良いのよね。: ……You can leave the pursuit to us, right?
m920202.……長い時を過ごした、屈辱の時間だった。\nだがそれも終わる、魔道は再び天を暗く:
……It was a long time I spent in humiliation.
But it is over now. The demonic path will once again shroud the heavens in darkness.
m920202.……長い闇の組織との戦いも終盤、\nこれからより激しさを増すでしょう。:
And with that, the curtain falls on this popular combatant's victory parade.

One thing settled, one chapter closed.
m920202.──そこまでだ、ノストラ。\nこの会議の目的は口論ではないはず。\nセブンを虐め: —That's enough, Nostra. The purpose of this meeting isn't to argue. Please stop picking on Seven.
m920202.──っ、嘘に決まってんだろ！\nこいつは昔っから信用ならねぇんだ！\nどうせ今回: —Tch, that's a load of lies! I've never been able to trust that woman! She's definitely up to something this time, too!
m920202.──で、まだ文句があるのかしら？: ──So, do you still have a complaint?
m920202.──なんで、テメェがここに。: —What the hell are you doing here?
m920202.──なッ、俺の爆弾が！？ いつから気づいて！？: ──Wha?! My bombs?! How long have you known?!
m920202.──まあ、失笑ですけどね。: ──Well, it's a laughable performance, at least.
m920202.──まずは古戦場という会場にも関わらず、\n多くの者が集まってくれたことに感謝し:
──First, I would like to express my gratitude that so many have gathered,
despite the venue being an ancient battlefield.
m920202.──ようやく戦力がバラバラになってくれましたね。: Mm, it's quite a sight to see so many ill-mannered people gathered here.
m920202.──ッ、ノストラじゃあねぇか！？\nまさかお前、組織を裏切ったのか！？:
──Tch, so it's you, Nostra!
Did you really betray the organization?
m920202.──ッ、怯えることはありません。\n亜神といえど武装もまだ整っていません、\n数:
──Tch. There is no need to fear.
Even as demi-gods, your equipment is not yet in order.
Crush them with the sheer force of numbers!
m920202.──ッ！ 紙一重だな、私の悪運もまだ強い。: ──Tch! By a hair's breadth. My luck is still strong.
m920202.──提案。\n人形使いは本体を仕留めるが定石、\nそれで厄介な人形も止まるはずで:
──Proposal.
Taking out the puppeteer is standard procedure.
That should stop the troublesome puppets as well.
m920202.──滑稽。芸がないとはこのことですね。: ──Ridiculous. Lacking in skill is exactly what this is.
m920202.──王国軍！？ しまった、深入りし過ぎた！: Dark Organization Member 1: —The Kingdom Army?! Damn it, we've gone too deep!
m920202.──魔道天下。: Will you cooperate with us? Nostra.
m920202.ああ、セブン……貴方の借金については、\n私も、悪いことをしたなって思っているわ:
Ah, Seven… about your debt…
I've been thinking I did wrong.
But I was just trying to survive, you know?
m920202.ああ、姐さんもいたのね、丁度良かったわ。: Ah, you're here too. How convenient.
m920202.あのワンという男、一体何を企んでいるのか……。:
...The long war against the Dark Organization is nearing its end,

and things are only going to get more intense from here.
m920202.あの日……闇ギルドが終わった日、\n私はギルド長の派閥だからって地下牢に監禁され:
That day… the day the Dark Guild ended…
I was locked in the dungeon just because I was on the Guild Master's side…
and I kept waiting for you to come save me.
m920202.あら、アイギス教徒も隣にいましてよ？\n姉妹神の信徒同士、共同作業と参りましょう:
Oh, an Aigis believer is right there too?
Let's work together, fellow worshippers of the Twin Goddesses.
m920202.ありがとうスリー、今日もうるさいわね。\n貴方が報連相もできない馬鹿で助かったわ:
Thank you, Three. You're really noisy today.
I'm glad I'm dealing with a fool who can't even report back.
m920202.あーあー、暢気なもんだぜ。\n俺が大量の爆弾を仕込んでるとも知らずに、\n感動的:
Aww, how carefree you all are.
Not a clue I'd planted a ton of bombs, and you're giving a rousing speech…
m920202.いいえスーシェンさん、それは違います。\n道化師というのは人を笑わせるのが仕事で:
No, that's not right, Shu-Xian.
A clown's job is to make people laugh.
In that regard, that Pierrot is quite the performer.
